title: Regional Integration Policies to Promote Transfer of Technologies in Public Health
affiliations: Texas A&M University School of Law

detail.title: Regional Integration Policies to Promote Transfer of Technologies in Public Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
On January 20, 2025, which is the first day of the second term of President Trump, the United States formally initiated the U.S. withdrawal from the World Health Organization’s (WHO) membership through a Presidential Executive Order. Ironically, the U.S had founded the WHO in 1948 in the aftermath of World War II, and established it as a specialized agency of the United Nations to promote global health and coordinate responses to health emergencies. When the termination process completed after the required 12-month notification period in 2026, it left the rest of the world to grapple with “what does a WHO divorced by the US mean for the rest of the world to enable access to healthcare?.”

The paper indulges in the question and underscores that capacity building through appropriate policies comporting with new realities is critical to achieving healthcare access. The paper presents policy options within a regional framework to promote transfer of technology and innovation with the goal of inducing more efficiency into regional and local pharmaceutical industry. Next, the paper will discuss components of innovation policy at a sub-regional/national level focusing on intellectual property policies that affect pharmaceutical research and access such as patents, licensing, know-how and transfer of technology. The study concludes by emphasizing the need for formal regional health centric instruments to promote regional cooperation in critical areas such as prosecution and regulatory approvals.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国退出世界卫生组织(WHO)后全球医疗卫生可及性面临的挑战，提出通过区域性政策框架、技术转移和创新政策来加强能力建设，以确保医疗保健的可及性。
AI.research_question: 美国退出WHO后，世界其他地区如何确保医疗保健的可及性？应采取何种政策来应对这一新局面？
AI.motivation: 2025年1月20日特朗普总统第二任期首日签署行政令，美国正式启动退出WHO程序，这给全球卫生治理带来重大不确定性，需要探讨后美国时代的卫生保健可及性方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域合作框架理论、创新政策理论、知识产权政策理论（涉及专利、许可、专有技术和技术的转移）
AI.method: 政策分析与规范性研究，提出区域层面的政策选项，结合次区域/国家层面的创新政策和知识产权政策分析，以及区域卫生文书和监管合作机制的设计。
AI.findings: 通过适当的政策进行能力建设对实现医疗保健可及性至关重要；需要在区域框架内促进技术创新与转移以提高区域和本地制药行业的效率；需要正式的区域卫生中心文书来促进关键领域（如诉讼和监管审批）的区域合作。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区域合作框架与知识产权政策分析相结合，为后美国WHO时代的全球卫生治理提供了新的政策分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了区域层面的具体政策选项，包括技术转移、制药产业效率提升、知识产权政策调整以及区域监管合作机制的设计建议。

title: Who Bears the Cycle? Time-Consistent Fiscal Policy and the Financing Assignment in Emerging Markets

detail.title: Who Bears the Cycle? Time-Consistent Fiscal Policy and the Financing Assignment in Emerging Markets
detail.abstract: Fiscal rules are often recommended to limit procyclical spending in emerging and developing economies. This paper looks at these rules using a calibrated small open-economy model. In the model, the government cannot commit in advance, so it chooses public spending each period and faces shocks to productivity, world interest rates, and household preferences. Results show that, despite the absence of political or default risks, procyclical spending remains the Markov-perfect best response. With public debt held constant, cyclical rules only shift the adjustment between spending and taxes rather than remove it. In this model, the main cost of discretion is the overall level of public purchases, not how it changes during the cycle. Sustained restraint would improve welfare, but a government making decisions year by year will not maintain it. Cyclical rules mostly shift which periods bear the cost. Rules focused on spending cause losses during times of tight fiscal limits, while rules focused on financing shift losses to high-productivity periods. In all the cases we study, the effect on the overall level is greater than the effect of shifting costs between periods.

AI.tldr: 本文通过校准的小型开放经济模型研究财政规则对新兴和发展中经济体中顺周期支出的影响。模型假设政府无法事先承诺，每期自主选择公共支出，并面临生产率、世界利率和家庭偏好冲击。结果显示，即使不存在政治或违约风险，顺周期支出仍是马尔可夫完美最优反应。财政规则的主要作用在于改变总支出水平而非消除周期性波动。
AI.research_question: 在政府无法承诺的动态模型中，财政规则能否有效限制新兴和发展中经济体的顺周期支出？这些规则的主要成本和收益是什么？
AI.motivation: 文献和政策界常推荐财政规则来限制新兴和发展中经济体的顺周期支出，但缺乏对其在政府缺乏承诺能力背景下效果的严谨模型分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 小型开放经济动态模型；马尔可夫完美均衡；政府无法事前承诺的离散时间动态博弈框架。
AI.method: 校准的小型开放经济模型，包含生产率、世界利率和家庭偏好三类冲击；政府每期无承诺地选择公共支出；通过数值模拟比较不同财政规则的效果。
AI.findings: 1) 无政治或违约风险时顺周期支出仍是马尔可夫完美最优反应；2) 在债务持平时周期性规则只是将调整在支出和税收间转移，而非消除；3) 自由裁量的主要成本是公共购买的整体水平而非其周期性变化；4) 持续的克制会改善福利，但逐年决策的政府无法维持；5) 周期性规则主要改变成本承担时期——支出规则在财政受限期造成损失，融资规则将损失转移到高生产率期；6) 所有情形中对总体水平的影响大于跨期成本转移的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明即使在缺乏政治或违约风险的情况下，顺周期支出仍是理性政府的最佳反应，挑战了将顺周期支出归因于制度缺陷的传统观点；阐明了财政规则的真实作用机制在于影响支出总体水平而非消除周期性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于财政规则设计的洞见：不同规则（支出型vs融资型）在成本分配上存在系统性差异，决策者应认识到财政规则的主要收益来自约束总体支出水平，而非消除周期性波动。

title: Governing for the Eye: Fiscal Salience, Perceived Return, and the Behavioral Political Economy of Systems Competition
affiliations: Duke Kunshan University

detail.title: Governing for the Eye: Fiscal Salience, Perceived Return, and the Behavioral Political Economy of Systems Competition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The atuhor declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No patients/participants are involved.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was acquired.

detail.abstract: Public debate increasingly frames infrastructure performance as evidence in a competition between political systems, contrasting, for instance, Germany's failing railways with China's high-speed network. This paper argues that such comparisons rest on a systematically biased measurement instrument: citizens' perceived fiscal return on investment (PF-ROI). Drawing on behavioral research on availability, experience sampling, and hedonic adaptation, I develop a theory in which citizens assess the state not by aggregating fiscal outcomes but by episodically sampling salient encounters with public output. Because public goods vary along a salience gradient, from highly experienceable physical infrastructure to invisible procedural and preventive goods that register only through failure, PF-ROI diverges predictably from actual fiscal efficiency. The model generates symmetric pathologies across regime types: performance-legitimacy regimes face a "salience treadmill" that rewards perpetual novel construction beyond the welfare optimum, while procedural-legitimacy regimes suffer a maintenance trap and legitimacy erosion despite comparable or superior fiscal returns. Political actors exploit the perception gap through salience arbitrage: liquidating invisible goods whose absence is unfelt until delayed, catastrophic failure. At the system level, internationally mediated salience competition drives global underprovision of invisible goods regardless of regime type. Eight falsifiable propositions link the framework to observable divergences between perceived and objective fiscal incidence, construction-to-maintenance budget ratios, and experimental salience interventions. The analysis reframes "systems competition" as a collective measurement failure rather than evidence of institutional superiority, and identifies conditions under which the bias can be corrected.

AI.tldr: 本文提出公民对财政投入回报的感知（PF-ROI）存在系统性测量偏差：公民并非通过汇总财政产出来评价国家，而是通过抽样体验显眼可见的公共品遭遇。公共品沿显性度梯度分布，导致PF-ROI与实际财政效率系统性偏离，进而催生不同政体类型的对称性病理（"显性度跑步机"与"维护陷阱"），并驱动全球范围内不可见公共品的供给不足。
AI.research_question: 不同政治体制的基础设施绩效比较（如德国铁路失败vs中国高铁成功）是否基于有偏的测量工具？即公民感知的财政投资回报率（PF-ROI）如何系统性偏离实际财政效率，并如何影响不同政体类型的公共品供给决策？
AI.motivation: 公共讨论日益将基础设施绩效视为政治体制竞争的证据，但这种比较可能建立在系统性的测量偏差之上。作者旨在揭示这种比较的认知基础谬误，并解释为何不同政体类型会产生对称性的公共品供给病理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为研究中的可用性启发（availability）、经验抽样（experience sampling）和享乐适应（hedonic adaptation）理论，结合公共品显性度梯度（salience gradient）框架。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念模型推导，提出八个可证伪的命题，将理论框架与可观察的经验现象（感知与实际财政负担的偏离、建设与维护预算比率、实验性显性度干预）相联系。
AI.findings: （1）PF-ROI与实际财政效率可预测地偏离；（2）绩效合法性政体面临"显性度跑步机"——持续追求新奇建设超出福利最优；（3）程序合法性政体陷入"维护陷阱"和合法性侵蚀，尽管财政回报相当或更优；（4）政治行动者通过"显性度套利"利用感知差距——清算不可见商品直到延迟的灾难性失败；（5）国际中介的显性度竞争导致全球范围内不可见商品的供给不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"体制竞争"重新框定为集体测量失败而非制度优越性的证据；提出PF-ROI概念作为连接行为认知与比较政治制度分析的理论桥梁；建立显性度梯度作为解释跨政体公共品供给偏差的统一框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出偏差可被纠正的条件，为政策制定者提供修正感知-实际财政效率偏差的诊断工具和干预方向，有助于改善维护性投资和不可见公共品的供给决策。

title: Two Faces of Political Violence: State Conflict, Civilian Insecurity, and Cryptocurrency Demand
affiliations: Texas State University, Texas State University and Texas State University

detail.title: Two Faces of Political Violence: State Conflict, Civilian Insecurity, and Cryptocurrency Demand
detail.abstract: We examine how political violence shapes retail cryptocurrency demand, leveragingthis setting to reconcile two competing views of cryptocurrencies: as speculative riskassets versus portable cross-border stores of value. We merge monthly country-levelcrypto exchange app downloads and active user metrics across G20 countries fromAugust 2015 to June 2022 with event-level conflict data. We distinguish between state conflict, which signals macro-political risk, and civilian insecurity, whichdirectly impacts households through localized predation. In two-way fixed-effects panelregressions, state conflict predicts reduced crypto participation, whereas civilian insecurity predicts heightened crypto adoption and participation. We further show that thenegative state-conflict effect intensifies under adverse institutional and crypto marketconditions, whereas the positive civilian-insecurity effect is strongest where householdshave access to digital financial rails. Overall, whether crypto functions as a speculativeasset or an escape hatch depends on the modality of political violence and theaccessibility of digital financial infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了政治暴力如何影响零售加密货币需求，区分了国家冲突（宏观政治风险信号）和民用不安全（直接影响家庭的本地化掠夺）两种暴力形态。基于G20国家2015年8月至2022年6月的月度加密货币交易所应用下载量及活跃用户数据，发现国家冲突会减少加密货币参与度，而民用不安全则会增强加密货币采用和参与。这一效应受到制度环境、加密市场条件及数字金融基础设施可获得性的调节。
AI.research_question: 政治暴力如何塑造零售加密货币需求？通过这一情境如何调和加密货币作为投机风险资产与便携跨境价值储存工具这两种竞争性观点？
AI.motivation: 加密货币存在两种竞争性理论定位：一是投机性风险资产，二是便携式跨境价值储存工具（即"逃生通道"）。已有文献未能很好地厘清在何种条件下哪种角色占主导，政治暴力提供了一个理想的外生情境来检验这两种观点的适用边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究整合了加密货币作为投机性风险资产的理论视角，与加密货币作为便携式跨境价值储存（逃生通道）的理论视角；并将政治暴力区分为国家冲突（宏观政治风险）与民用不安全（本地化掠夺影响家庭）两种类型进行理论区分。
AI.method: 采用G20国家2015年8月至2022年6月月度数据，合并加密货币交易所应用下载量和活跃用户指标与事件级冲突数据，运用双向固定效应面板回归进行实证检验，并考察制度条件、加密市场条件和数字金融基础设施的调节效应。
AI.findings: （1）国家冲突显著降低加密货币参与度；（2）民用不安全显著提高加密货币采用与参与度；（3）国家冲突的负面效应在不利制度和加密市场条件下更强；（4）民用不安全的正面效应在家庭可及数字金融基础设施的国家最强。表明加密货币究竟充当投机资产还是逃生通道，取决于政治暴力的形态和数字金融基础设施的可获得性。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究调和了加密货币作为投机风险资产与便携跨境价值储存工具的竞争性理论观点，提出并验证了政治暴力类型（国家冲突vs民用不安全）作为区分这两种角色的关键边界条件，丰富了关于加密货币经济角色和政治风险对金融参与影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解政治动荡环境下加密货币流动的驱动因素提供实证依据；帮助监管机构识别加密货币在冲突情境中扮演的社会角色（投机工具vs避险工具）；为数字金融基础设施建设和金融普惠政策提供参考。

title: Does News Come True? Evidence from Initial Unemployment Claims

detail.title: Does News Come True? Evidence from Initial Unemployment Claims
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates whether a news shock identified in real time carries out-ofsample forecasting content for the variable from which it is extracted. Weekly U.S. data for 1982-2026 are used to identify a Barsky-Sims maximum-forecasterror-variance-share news shock to log initial unemployment claims, re-estimated on rolling windows at each of 1,798 forecast origins. The shock delivers no usable forecasting content: it raises mean squared forecast error at every horizon from one to eight weeks under squared, absolute and Huber loss, at a cost of between 768 and 3,856 claims per week against a mean level of 331,000, and the forecast from the news-augmented VAR itself-the system in which the shock is identified-trails the univariate benchmarks at every horizon. A fluctuation test rejects stability of relative accuracy, but the variation is a level shift rather than a regime in which news worked: pre-2020 differences are an order of magnitude smaller than the deterioration that follows once a rolling identification window begins to retain the pandemic observations. Running the identical pipeline on the Barsky-Sims technology-news system yields the same forecasting verdict. In-sample identification success and out-of-sample forecasting value are distinct properties.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了实时识别的新闻冲击是否对提取该冲击的变量具有样本外预测能力。基于1982-2026年美国周度数据，识别Barsky-Sims最大预测误差方差份额的新闻冲击（来自对数初始失业救济金申请），在1798个预测原点通过滚动窗口重新估计。结果表明该冲击没有任何可用的预测内容：在所有1至8周预测区间内，冲击增强了均方预测误差（在平方、绝对和Huber损失下均如此），每周成本在768至3856个失业救济金申请之间（平均水平为331,000），且新闻增强VAR的预测在每个区间内都落后于单变量基准。波动性检验拒绝了相对精度的稳定性，但波动是水平位移而非新闻有效的工作机制：2020年前的差异比滚动识别窗口开始保留大流行观察后的恶化小一个数量级。在Barsky-Sims技术新闻系统上运行相同流程得出相同的预测结论。样本内识别成功与样本外预测价值是不同的属性。
AI.research_question: 实时识别出的新闻冲击是否对提取该冲击的变量具有样本外预测价值（out-of-sample forecasting content）？
AI.motivation: 新闻冲击在样本内识别上已取得广泛成功，但样本外预测能力的检验相对缺乏。本文旨在通过严格的滚动窗口样本外评估，检验新闻冲击是否真正具有可用的预测内容，从而区分样本内识别成功与样本外预测价值这两个不同的属性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Barsky-Sims（2011）最大预测误差方差份额（maximum forecast error variance share）新闻冲击识别方法；结构VAR模型中的新闻冲击理论。
AI.method: 基于1982-2026年美国周度数据，从对数初始失业救济金申请中识别Barsky-Sims新闻冲击；采用滚动窗口（1798个预测原点）重新估计；比较新闻增强VAR与单变量基准在1-8周预测区间上的表现，使用平方、绝对和Huber损失函数；进行波动性检验（fluctuation test）评估相对精度稳定性；同时对Barsky-Sims技术新闻系统运行相同流程进行稳健性验证。
AI.findings: （1）新闻冲击在所有预测区间和所有损失函数下均提高均方预测误差，每周预测成本为768-3856个失业救济金申请（均值331,000）；（2）新闻增强VAR的预测在每个区间上均落后于单变量基准；（3）波动性检验拒绝相对精度稳定性，但波动源于水平位移而非新闻有效机制；（4）2020年前差异显著更小，滚动识别窗口纳入大流行观察后出现急剧恶化；（5）在技术新闻系统上运行相同流程得到一致的负面结论。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）实证揭示了样本内识别成功与样本外预测价值是两个独立的属性；（2）对Barsky-Sims新闻冲击方法的实际预测效用提出了质疑；（3）表明结构识别的严格性并不自动转化为预测能力的提升。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者和预测实践者提供了新闻冲击在预测应用中的局限性的直接证据；（2）指出大流行等结构性断点会影响滚动窗口识别的稳定性，需警惕此类事件对预测模型的影响；（3）建议在应用新闻冲击进行实时预测时需谨慎评估其实际增益。

title: The Effects of Environmental Racism
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Effects of Environmental Racism

keywords: Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool

detail.abstract: Environmental racism refers to the disproportionate placement of pollution sources and environmental hazards near communities of color, Indigenous populations, and low-income neighborhoods, a pattern rooted in decades of discriminatory housing, zoning, and lending practices. This paper examines the historical origins of environmental racism, tracing its connection to redlining and residential segregation, and analyzes its far-reaching consequences for public health, including elevated rates of asthma, cardiovascular disease, cancer, and mental health strain among affected populations. Using Cancer Alley, Louisiana as a case study, the paper illustrates how prolonged industrial exposure devastates predominantly Black communities across generations. Beyond health outcomes, the paper explores the social and economic toll of environmental racism, including declining property values, inadequate infrastructure, and educational setbacks caused by chronic pollution exposure. Finally, it evaluates potential solutions, emphasizing the roles of government policy, corporate accountability, grassroots environmental justice movements, and technological tools such as the Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool (CEJST) in identifying and addressing environmental disparities. The paper concludes that meaningfully reducing environmental racism requires coordinated efforts across governments, businesses, nonprofits, and individuals to ensure equitable environmental protection regardless of race or income.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了环境种族主义的历史根源、健康与社会经济后果，并以路易斯安那州"Cancerc Alley"（癌症巷）为案例，分析了政府政策、企业责任、草根运动和CEJST工具等解决方案，强调需多方协同以实现环境公平。
AI.research_question: 环境种族主义的历史根源是什么？它对公共健康、社会和经济产生哪些深远影响？如何通过政策、企业和社区行动有效解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 环境种族主义长期影响有色人种社区和低收入群体的健康与生活质量，但对其历史根源、多维后果及解决路径缺乏系统性梳理，亟需深入分析以推动环境正义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境正义理论、批判种族理论、结构性不平等理论
AI.method: 文献综述与案例分析（以路易斯安那州"癌症巷"为案例）
AI.findings: 环境种族主义源于数十年歧视性住房、分区和贷款政策（如红线和居住隔离）；其后果包括哮喘、心血管疾病、癌症、心理健康问题高发，以及房产贬值、基础设施不足和教育受阻；解决方案需政府、企业、非营利组织、个人协同努力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了环境种族主义从历史政策根源到当代多维后果的理论链条，丰富了环境正义理论在结构性不平等与公共健康交叉领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出并评估了包括CEJST在内的政策和技术工具在识别环境不公中的应用价值，为政府决策、企业ESG实践和社区行动提供了可操作的参考框架。

title: Architecting Systems for Human Flourishing – The ASPIRE® Framework: Curriculum Symbiosis and LLM-Driven Qualitative Analytics across Secondary and Tertiary Education

detail.title: Architecting Systems for Human Flourishing – The ASPIRE® Framework: Curriculum Symbiosis and LLM-Driven Qualitative Analytics across Secondary and Tertiary Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved semi-structured qualitative fieldwork and expert consultations. All expert reviews and qualitative feedback were conducted with full informed consent from all participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or external financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Modern educational institutions face a structural "trilemma" in which they must continuously trade off academic rigor, stakeholder well-being, and scalable operational equity. High-stakes academic frameworks frequently hit a systemic complexity ceiling characterized by a student burnout rate of ~40%, severe faculty administrative fatigue, and an administrative "double-work tax." Furthermore, international curriculum models may suffer from “Eurocentric hegemony”, creating perceived cultural dissonance and vocational stigma.

This paper introduces the ASPIRE® Ecosystem (AI-Synthesized Portal for Integrated Readiness & Excellence), a registered operational architecture designed to resolve these systemic frictions. Grounded in signal decoupling theory, qualitative fieldwork across Latin American secondary environments, and enterprise data modeling, ASPIRE® integrates five core sub-frameworks: SafeGuard (a local-first feasibility auditing protocol), SOURCE (curriculum symbiosis, industry integration, and "rooted globalism"), The LINK Initiative (structural mental health load-balancing), PRISM (an eight-axis LLM qualitative learning analytics engine), and BEACON (longitudinal alumni outcome tracking).

The ASPIRE® Architecture reframes Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive content generators into active metacognitive mirrors and universal analytical translators, ensuring innovation is deeply rooted in local identity while frictionlessly maintaining global academic reach through national-international alignment. This framework is highly scale-invariant, translating seamlessly from upper-secondary pathways into higher-education ecosystems and lifelong learning trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPIRE®生态系统，一个旨在解决现代教育机构中学术严谨性、利益相关者福祉和可扩展运营公平性之间结构性"三难困境"的综合运营架构。该架构基于信号解耦理论，整合五大核心子框架，将大语言模型重新定位为元认知镜像和通用分析翻译器，以实现本土认同与全球学术触达的平衡。
AI.research_question: 现代教育机构如何在学术严谨性、利益相关者福祉和可扩展运营公平性三者之间突破结构性"三难困境"？此外，如何克服国际课程模式的"欧洲中心霸权"文化失调与职业污名问题？
AI.motivation: 当前教育体系面临多重系统性摩擦：高压力学术框架导致约40%的学生倦怠率、教师行政管理疲劳和行政"双重工作税"；同时国际课程模型存在欧洲中心主义倾向，造成文化失调和职业污名，亟需一个全面的系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号解耦理论（signal decoupling theory），辅以拉丁美洲中等教育环境的定性田野调查和企业数据建模作为方法论基础。
AI.method: 本文采用多方法混合设计：（1）基于信号解耦理论的概念框架构建；（2）拉丁美洲中等教育环境的定性田野调查；（3）企业数据建模；（4）提出包含五个核心子框架的综合架构——SafeGuard（本地优先可行性审计）、SOURCE（课程共生与行业融合）、LINK倡议（心理健康负载平衡）、PRISM（八轴LLM定性学习分析引擎）和BEACON（纵向校友成果追踪）。
AI.findings: ASPIRE®架构能够将大语言模型从被动内容生成器转变为主动元认知镜像和通用分析翻译器，确保创新根植于本地认同，同时通过国家-国际对齐维持全球学术触达。该框架具有高度规模不变性，可从高中阶段无缝扩展到高等教育和终身学习路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过将信号解耦理论应用于教育运营架构设计，拓展了该理论在教育管理领域的解释力；同时重新概念化了大语言模型在教育中的角色定位（从内容生成器到元认知镜像与分析翻译器），为LLM教育应用提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了经过注册的、可直接实施的ASPIRE®运营架构，包括五大可操作子框架；解决了学生倦怠（约40%）、教师行政疲劳和行政"双重工作税"等实际问题；为国际课程的本土化融合（"扎根的全球主义"）提供了可落地的实践路径。

title: Forecasting Foundational Learning in India: A Pre-Registered Probabilistic Assessment of NIPUN Bharat

detail.title: Forecasting Foundational Learning in India: A Pre-Registered Probabilistic Assessment of NIPUN Bharat

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed in the education sector in India. No data from the author's employer was used in this study; all data are drawn from publicly published sources (ASER Centre, PARAKH/NCERT, UDISE+, Reserve Bank of India, EPW Research Foundation). The author has no financial interest in any organisation implementing or evaluating NIPUN Bharat, and received no compensation related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human subjects and no primary data collection. It is a secondary analysis of publicly published aggregate statistics; no individual- level or identifiable data were accessed at any stage.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: India’s NIPUN Bharat mission targets universal foundational literacy and numeracy by the end of Grade 3 in 2026-27. Existing assessments of progress report point estimates or scenario sets; none is committed to before the outcome is observable, and none quantifies how much of the answer is driven by assumptions rather than data. We construct a state-level panel of Grade 3 reading and numeracy outcomes spanning six ASER rounds (2012–2024), recovering two pre-2016 rounds from ASER’s published competency ladder and validating the reconstruction to exact agreement against later published tables. We fit a partially pooled trajectory model on the logit scale, treat COVID-19 as a level shock with an explicit recovery parameter, and calibrate forecast uncertainty from a genuine out-of-sample backtest rather than in-sample standard errors. Policy-effect priors are taken from the randomised-trial literature rather than estimated from observational panels, because programme allocation in India responds to need. 1. Three findings. First, the target will be missed by a wide margin on both indicators: the mean modelled probability of any state reaching 80% by 2026-27 is 0.001 for reading and 0.000 for numeracy, and no state is more likely than not to reach 60% on reading. This conclusion is arithmetically visible without a model—reaching 80% requires 53% of all Grade 3 children to climb one to three rungs of the competency ladder in two years, against a pre-COVID improvement rate of 0.98 percentage points annually. Second, and more consequentially for the forecasting literature, irreducible forecast error dominates everything else: a two-year-ahead forecast carries a measured out-of-sample error of 6.5 percentage points, accounting for 80% of forecast variance, against 17% for the post-COVID recovery assumption and 1% for the entire range of plausible policy effects. Neither the assumption analysts argue about nor the policies they recommend move the answer as much as the basic difficulty of forecasting two years ahead. This result is robust for reading under every recovery specification we test, but in a pre-specified extension to Grade 3 numeracy it does not replicate: there the recovery assumption is far more consequential, and which source dominates cannot be resolved with only two post-COVID observations. We report the non-replication rather than restricting the analysis to the indicator on which the finding holds. That extension also shows a divergence the reading-only analysis could not: reading was improving at 0.98 percentage points a year before the pandemic and remains below its 2018 level, whereas numeracy was nearly flat at 0.31 and has now exceeded its pre-COVID trajectory in 13 of 22 states — an apparent numeracy recovery that reflects a low counterfactual bar rather than a healthier system. Third, two national instruments measuring Grade 3 in the same season — ASER and PARAKH Rashtriya Sarvekshan 2024 — rank states at a Spearman correlation of only 0.41 for reading and 0.22 for numeracy. A multitrait-multimethod analysis attributes this to a method effect rather than measurement error: same-method correlations average 0.71 against 0.32 for different-method same-trait, and disattenuating for sampling error (ASER state reliability 0.986) moves the reading correlation only from 0.413 to 0.426. A threshold measure and a mean-score measure capture different features of a state’s ability distribution — and NIPUN’s own target is a threshold. We pre-register the forecast, with falsifiable calibration claims, before ASER 2026 is fielded.

AI.tldr: 本文构建2012-2024年印度各邦三年级阅读和算术成绩面板数据，使用部分池化轨迹模型预测NIPUN Bharat使命（2026-27年实现80%基础素养达标）的实现概率。研究发现目标将被大幅错过（阅读和算术达标概率分别为0.001和0.000），且不可约的预测误差（两年期外样本误差6.5个百分点）主导了预测方差，远超疫情恢复假设和政策效应的影响。此外，ASER与PARAKH两项国家评估工具对邦排名的相关性极低（阅读0.41，算术0.22），揭示方法效应而非测量误差所致。
AI.research_question: NIPUN Bharat使命能否在2026-27年前实现三年级基础素养和算术的普及目标？预测不确定性中，数据驱动与假设驱动的成分各占多少？两项国家评估工具（ASER与PARAKH）对邦级排名的分歧源于测量误差还是方法效应？
AI.motivation: 现有评估只报告点估计或情景集，既未在结果可观察前做出承诺性预测，也未量化预测中假设与数据的相对贡献。此外，需要严格的外样本回测而非内样本标准误来校准预测不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分池化轨迹模型（partial pooling trajectory model）、对数几率（logit）尺度建模、COVID-19水平冲击与显式恢复参数、多特质多方法分析（MTMM）、预测不确定性校准理论
AI.method: 构建覆盖六轮ASER调查（2012-2024）的邦级面板，从ASER已发布的胜任力阶梯恢复两轮2016年前数据并验证精确一致。在logit尺度上拟合部分池化轨迹模型，将COVID-19视为带显式恢复参数的水平冲击。预测不确定性通过真实外样本回测校准。政策效应先验取自随机试验文献而非观测面板估计。使用MTMM分析评估工具差异。
AI.findings: 1) 目标将大幅错过：任何邦达到80%的概率几乎为零（阅读0.001，算术0.000），无邦有超过50%概率在阅读上达60%。2) 不可约预测误差主导预测方差（80%），疫情恢复假设占17%，政策效应仅占1%。该发现在阅读指标上稳健，但在算术指标上不复制——恢复假设在算术上更关键。3) 算术在疫情后看似恢复（13/22邦超过疫情前轨迹），但这反映低反事实基准而非更健康的系统。4) ASER与PARAKH排名相关性仅0.41（阅读）和0.22（算术），MTMM显示方法效应而非测量误差所致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对印度基础教育政策目标做出可证伪的预注册预测；证明在长期教育预测中，外样本校准的不可约预测误差可能主导假设和政策效应；揭示阈值度量与均值度量捕捉能力分布的不同特征；报告非复制结果而非选择性呈现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NIPUN Bharat使命提供基于数据的可实现性评估，明确指出其在当前改善速度下无法达标；量化疫情恢复假设和政策变化对预测的相对重要性，提醒政策制定者评估工具的差异（ASER与PARAKH排名差异巨大）可能影响问责和政策制定。

title: Vote Selling as a Survival Strategy: The Influence of Poverty and Food Insecurity on Electoral Behaviour in Nigeria
affiliations: Zicolin Power Institute, Zicolin Power Institute and Zicolin Power Institute

detail.title: Vote Selling as a Survival Strategy: The Influence of Poverty and Food Insecurity on Electoral Behaviour in Nigeria

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no personal, professional, or financial relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the conduct, analysis, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical principles were observed throughout the study. Participation was voluntary, informed consent was obtained from all respondents, and participants were assured of anonymity and confidentiality. No personally identifiable information was collected, and the data were used solely for academic research purposes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external financial funding. The study was conducted using the authors' own resources.

detail.abstract: This study investigated vote selling as an economic survival strategy among Nigerian voters, examining the extent to which poverty and food insecurity influence transactional voting during elections. Anchored on Rational Choice Theory and Political Clientelism Theory, the primary objective was to determine whether acute socioeconomic pressures drive voter participation in clientelist networks, while assessing public perceptions regarding its broader implications for democratic governance. A quantitative survey design was adopted, yielding a sample of 1,605 valid respondents analyzed through descriptive statistics, Cronbach's Alpha reliability testing, Pearson Product-Moment correlation, multiple linear regression, and subgroup variance tests (ANOVA and Independent Samples t-test).

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了尼日利亚选民将出售选票作为一种经济生存策略的现象，考察贫困和粮食不安全感在多大程度上影响交易性投票行为。基于理性选择理论和政治庇护主义理论，通过定量调查（1,605名有效受访者）运用描述性统计、信度检验、相关性分析、多元线性回归和方差分析等方法，揭示急性社会经济压力如何驱动选民参与庇护主义网络，并评估公众对其民主治理影响的认知。
AI.research_question: 贫困和粮食不安全感在多大程度上驱动尼日利亚选民的交易性投票（出售选票）行为？公众如何看待这一现象对民主治理的广泛影响？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚选民的出售选票行为可能源于深层的社会经济生存压力，而非单纯的政治腐败，研究这一现象有助于理解贫困与民主参与之间的复杂关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性选择理论（Rational Choice Theory）和政治庇护主义理论（Political Clientelism Theory）
AI.method: 采用定量调查设计，收集1,605名有效受访者样本，使用描述性统计、Cronbach's Alpha信度检验、Pearson积矩相关分析、多元线性回归、以及ANOVA和独立样本t检验等群体方差检验方法。
AI.findings: 待论文正文揭示结果，但研究假设为贫困和粮食不安全感显著影响交易性投票行为，且公众对此持有关切性认知。
AI.theory_contributions: 将理性选择理论与政治庇护主义理论相结合，为理解经济生存压力驱动下的选票出售行为提供了理论整合视角，拓展了交易性投票研究的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果可为尼日利亚及类似发展中国家制定减少贫困、保障粮食安全的政策提供依据，并为选举治理改革和反腐败措施提供实证参考。

title: Health as a Fundamental Right in Nepal: Legal Provisions and Implementation Gaps

detail.title: Health as a Fundamental Right in Nepal: Legal Provisions and Implementation Gaps
detail.abstract: The Constitution of Nepal, 2015, recognizes health as a fundamental right of all citizens. The Constitution, article 35 provides for the right to free basic health services, emergency health care and equal access to health services without discrimination. This constitutional commitment is a major legal achievement in the transformation of Nepal to a federal democratic republic. There remains, however, a wide gap between the legal provisions and their actual implementation. This paper is a case study of health as a basic right in Nepal. It discusses the legal framework, the institutional set up for health services and the persisting implementation gaps that deny millions of Nepali citizens their constitutional right to health. Drawing on publicly available data from the Ministry of Health and Population, World Health Organization, World Bank, Central Bureau of Statistics and other sources, the analysis shows that Nepal continues to grapple with serious health challenges, despite constitutional guaranties. Out-of-pocket health expenditure is high at about 55 percent of total health spending, pushing many households into poverty. Health infrastructure is unevenly distributed among provinces and local governments. The health budget has increased but remains below international levels. Maternal mortality is still high and non-communicable diseases are on the rise. The paper highlights some gaps in implementation like weak legal enforcement mechanisms, health financing, health workers, health infrastructure and governance, social discrimination and awareness of health rights. The case study also discusses specific examples of these gaps such as between urban and rural areas, difficulties in remote mountain districts, and the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. The paper concludes with recommendations on strengthening legal enforcement, scaling up health financing, enhancing capacity of health systems, promoting health equity and empowering citizens to claim their health rights. The findings have implications for Nepal's ongoing federal transition, as well as for other developing countries that have recognized health as a fundamental right, but have failed to realize this right in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文以尼泊尔为案例，考察健康作为基本宪法权利（2015年宪法第35条）在法律框架与现实实施之间的巨大差距。尽管宪法保障公民享有免费基本健康服务、紧急医疗和不受歧视的平等医疗权利，但分析显示尼泊尔仍面临高额自付医疗支出（约占55%）、卫生基础设施分布不均、孕产妇死亡率高、非传染性疾病上升等严峻挑战。论文指出法律执行机制薄弱、卫生筹资不足、卫生工作者短缺、治理不善、社会歧视及健康权利意识欠缺等实施缺陷，并提出了加强法律执行、扩大卫生筹资、提升卫生系统能力、促进健康公平和赋权公民等建议。
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔宪法将健康确认为基本权利后，法律条款与实际实施之间为何存在巨大差距？这些实施缺陷的具体表现及其成因是什么？
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔2015年宪法在联邦民主共和国转型中首次将健康确认为基本权利，这是重大的法律成就，但法律承诺与现实之间存在显著鸿沟，数以百万计的公民无法实现其宪法健康权利。论文旨在系统梳理这一差距并为政策改进提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以健康权为基本权利的法理框架为基础，结合宪法权利实施理论、卫生公平理论和联邦制下医疗卫生治理理论进行分析。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，利用尼泊尔卫生与人口部、世界卫生组织、世界银行、中央统计局等机构的公开数据进行定性与定量相结合的分析。
AI.findings: （1）自付医疗支出高，约占卫生总支出的55%，将许多家庭推入贫困；（2）卫生基础设施在各邦和地方政府间分布不均；（3）卫生预算虽有增加但仍低于国际水平；（4）孕产妇死亡率仍较高，非传染性疾病呈上升趋势；（5）存在法律执行机制薄弱、卫生筹资不足、卫生工作者与基础设施短缺、治理不善、社会歧视以及公民对健康权利意识不足等多重实施缺口；（6）城乡差距、偏远山区医疗困难和COVID-19疫情加剧了这些挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为宪法健康权利从"纸面权利"到"现实权利"的转化研究提供了发展中国家（尤其是联邦转型国家）的实证案例，揭示了宪法承诺与实施之间结构性鸿沟的机理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔的联邦转型提供了加强法律执行、扩大卫生筹资、提升卫生系统能力、促进健康公平、赋权公民主张健康权利等具体政策建议，对已承认健康为基本权利但未能实现该权利的其他发展中国家具有借鉴意义。

title: PhD Project: Mixed Markets, Mixed Enforcement? An Empirical Study of Competition Law Enforcement against State-owned Enterprises
affiliations: Utrecht University School of Law and

detail.title: PhD Project: Mixed Markets, Mixed Enforcement? An Empirical Study of Competition Law Enforcement against State-owned Enterprises

keywords: Mixed Enforcement? An Empirical Study of EU Competition Law Enforcement Against State-Owned Enterprises

detail.abstract:
State ownership has been rediscovered across the EU for industrial policy purposes, proving effective in the pursuit of strategic autonomy and sustainability transitions. State-owned enterprises (SOEs) are historically prominent in critical markets such as energy, extraction, utilities, finance and transportation, while allowing for more government influence than in private firms.

The above developments have led to a resurgence of state ownership through nationalization, active shareholding and subsidization in the EU, creating new risks for so-called mixed markets, where SOEs and private firms compete. This, in turn, raises questions about competition law enforcement of such markets. SOEs may be inclined to behave anticompetitively and create obstacles for private enterprises. However, there is little understanding of how competition law is enforced against SOEs in practice. This PhD research seeks to establish the first empirical insights into the practice and constraints of competition law enforcement against SOEs. 

• As PhD researcher, you will undertake a 4-year research project aimed at answering to what extent, and on what grounds, the enforcement of EU competition law differs between State-owned enterprises and private undertakings. 
• This PhD project envisions a mixed methods approach, combining data-driven, experimental and qualitative methodologies.
• The envisioned output of this PhD is 4 academic articles suitable for publication in peer-reviewed academic journals in competition law or policy.
• Throughout this project you will work in close collaboration with two dedicated PhD supervisors, who will coach you towards becoming an independent academic researcher.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇PhD研究项目简介，旨在通过混合研究方法，首次建立欧盟竞争法对国有企业与私营企业执法差异的实证洞察，探究欧盟竞争法执法在何种程度及基于何种理由对国有企业与私营企业有所不同。
AI.research_question: 欧盟竞争法对国有企业与私营企业的执法在何种程度上、基于何种理由存在差异？
AI.motivation: 欧盟范围内国有所有权因产业政策目的（战略自主与可持续转型）而复兴，导致混合市场中国有企业与私营企业竞争加剧。国有企业可能倾向反竞争行为并阻碍私营企业，但现有研究对竞争法在实践中如何针对国有企业执行知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未明确提及特定理论框架，但涉及竞争法执法理论、国家所有权与产业政策理论、混合市场经济理论等。
AI.method: 混合研究方法（mixed methods），结合数据驱动、实验性和定性方法；产出为4篇学术论文。
AI.findings: 该研究为进行中的项目，尚未有具体研究发现；预期成果是提供关于竞争法对国有企业执法实践与约束的首个实证见解。
AI.theory_contributions: 为竞争法领域提供首个针对国有企业执法实践的实证基础，填补竞争法执法与国有企业研究之间的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和执法机构提供关于如何平衡国有企业与私营企业竞争关系的实践洞见，有助于完善混合市场中的竞争执法策略。

title: Measuring Audit Oversight Activities with Large Language Models: Evidence from Japan
affiliations: and

detail.title: Measuring Audit Oversight Activities with Large Language Models: Evidence from Japan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only publicly available corporate disclosures and does not involve human subjects; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS) KAKENHI Grant Number JP23K01677.

detail.abstract: The activities of audit-oversight bodies, most notably audit committees in U.S. and U.K. firms, are central to the reliability of financial reporting. Evidence on them, however, rests largely on inputs and structural attributes (independence, expertise, meeting frequency, governance form), which capture the capacity for oversight and leave the substance of what these bodies do unobserved. We address this gap in Japan, where annual securities reports have been required since 2019 to describe those activities in narrative form. Applying a large language model (GPT-4o) to read that narrative in context, we construct an Audit Oversight Score (AOS) that grades reported oversight activity at scale, separating specific and evidenced activity from boilerplate instead of counting words, and split it into the body's own activity (ACT) and its coordination with the external auditor (COORD). The measure agrees with human coders as closely as two human coders agree with each other, and is reproduced by three other models. In an FY2019-FY2024 panel, substantive differences persist across firms and are not explained by the governance structure a firm has chosen. Firms scoring higher pay higher audit fees, consistent with oversight and the external audit being complements. During the COVID-19 pandemic, when incentives to misreport rose, a higher ACT is associated with smaller absolute discretionary accruals even within the same firm. Both associations run through ACT rather than COORD, an asymmetry visible only once oversight is measured along two dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用日本2019年起要求年度证券报告以叙述形式描述审计监督活动的规定，运用大语言模型（GPT-4o）构建了审计监督评分（AOS），将审计委员会的实际活动从模板化文本中区分开来，并区分为自身活动（ACT）和与外部审计师的协调（COORD）两个维度。研究发现实质性差异不被治理结构所解释，且AOS与审计费用正相关，高ACT与更小的应计利润操纵相关。
AI.research_question: 审计监督机构（尤其是审计委员会）的实际活动内容如何被系统性度量？这些度量是否与治理结构无关、并能解释审计费用和财务报告质量的经济后果？
AI.motivation: 现有关于审计监督的实证证据主要依赖输入性和结构属性（独立性、专业性、会议频率、治理形式），这些指标只捕捉了监督能力而无法观测监督的实际内容（substance）。作者希望填补这一空白，将监督的"实际做了什么"与"结构上具备什么能力"区分开来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审计监督的实质性内容理论——区分监督能力（capacity）与监督实施（substance）；审计监督与外部审计的互补性理论；代理理论下信息披露质量与盈余管理激励的关系。
AI.method: 应用大语言模型（GPT-4o）对日本年度证券报告中的叙述性审计监督描述进行上下文阅读，构建审计监督评分（AOS），区分具体有证据的活动与模板化表述，并拆分为自身活动（ACT）和与外部审计师协调（COORD）两维度；运用人工编码者验证一致性，并用其他三个模型进行可复现性检验；在FY2019-FY2024面板数据中进行回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）AOS与人工编码的一致性接近两位人工编码者之间的一致性水平，且能被三个其他模型复现；（2）公司间的实质性监督差异持久存在，且不被公司选择的治理结构所解释；（3）评分更高的公司支付更高的审计费用，表明监督与外部审计是互补关系；（4）COVID-19疫情期间，当误报激励上升时，较高的ACT与更小的绝对可自由裁量应计利润相关（即使在同家公司内部）；（5）上述关联均通过ACT而非COORD起作用，这种不对称性只有在将监督度量拆分为两个维度时才可见。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将审计监督从"结构性属性"转向"实质性内容"进行度量，区分了监督能力与监督实施；揭示了监督自身活动与外部审计协调的经济后果不对称性，深化了对监督与审计互补性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大语言模型在会计与审计研究中的应用提供了范例；为监管机构评估审计监督有效性提供了可扩展的自动化度量工具；为投资者和公司治理实践提供了关于何种监督活动更具实质性价值的证据。

title: Invariant Regimes in Boltzmann -Lotka -Volterra Dynamics

detail.title: Invariant Regimes in Boltzmann -Lotka -Volterra Dynamics
detail.abstract: Boltzmann-Lotka-Volterra (BLV) frameworks are widely used to model artificial complex systems such as urban dynamics, spatial economics, mobility, and contagion processes. Over several decades these models have undergone substantial refinement, incorporating richer algebraic structures, multiscale coupling, behavioral heterogeneity, and empirical calibration. Despite this increasing sophistication, recurrent qualitative features (including regime multiplicity, path dependence, tipping points, and strong sensitivity to initial conditions) persist across applications. This paper examines BLV-based models from a structural dynamical perspective. Fixing a canonical BLV formulation, we analyze how successive refinements modify functional expressions while preserving the underlying dynamical operator. We show that refinements that preserve entropy-normalized allocation, multiplicative Lotka-Volterra interaction structure, and state-space dimensionality leave the qualitative regime topology invariant. As a result, increasing model sophistication can improve descriptive resolution without expanding the space of dynamically admissible behaviors. This invariance leads to a phenomenon we term structural saturation, in which successive epistemological refinements stabilize and map regime boundaries without altering the qualitative structure of the dynamical system. The analysis clarifies the structural domain within which BLV frameworks operate and provides a criterion for  distinguishing productive refinement from situations where qualitative behavior cannot change without modifying the underlying operator. The results suggest that persistent qualitative features observed in BLV applications may reflect intrinsic properties of the operator rather than insufficient model refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文从结构动力学视角系统分析了Boltzmann-Lotka-Volterra（BLV）框架的建模性质，证明在保持熵归一化分配、乘法Lotka-Volterra交互结构和状态空间维度不变的条件下，模型的各种精细化改进不会改变定性动力学拓扑，从而提出"结构饱和"概念，说明BLV应用中持续出现的定性特征可能是算子内在属性而非模型不够精细所致。
AI.research_question: BLV框架经过数十年精细化改进后，其定性动力学特征（如多重均衡、路径依赖、临界点、初值敏感性）为何持续存在？模型精细化是否真能扩展动力学可允许行为的空间？
AI.motivation: BLV模型在多个复杂系统领域被广泛使用且不断得到精细化，但定性特征始终如一，这引发了一个根本性疑问：模型精细化的价值边界在哪里，以及持续出现的定性现象究竟是模型缺陷还是算子内在属性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Boltzmann-Lotka-Volterra动力学框架、结构动力学分析、定性动力学（regime topology）、熵归一化分配、乘法Lotka-Volterra交互结构理论
AI.method: 采用结构动力学分析方法，固定典型BLV公式作为基准，推导检验各种模型精细化修改在保持核心结构约束（熵归一化分配、乘法交互结构、状态空间维度）条件下是否改变定性动力学拓扑，通过不变性分析论证结构饱和现象。
AI.findings: （1）保持熵归一化分配、乘法Lotka-Volterra交互结构和状态空间维度的模型精细化不会改变定性动力学拓扑；（2）模型精细化只能提高描述分辨率，不能扩大动力学可允许行为空间；（3）提出"结构饱和"概念，即精细化改进最终稳定并映射出边界而不改变定性结构；（4）BLV应用中持续出现的定性特征可能是算子内在属性，而非模型不够精细所致。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出"结构饱和"理论概念，界定BLV框架结构性操作域；（2）建立了模型精细化程度与定性动力学行为空间之间的不变性定理；（3）为区分有效精细化与无法改变定性行为的精细化提供了判断标准。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为研究人员提供判断何时应放弃BLV框架而修改底层算子的指导准则；（2）帮助识别哪些精细化改进是有效生产力投资，哪些无法带来定性行为变化；（3）解释了跨领域BLV应用中定性特征一致性的深层原因。

It does not involve new primary data collection from human participants; ethics approval was therefore not required.
