detail.abstract: Pakistan has developed an increasingly sophisticated formal architecture for responding to human trafficking-the Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act 2018, a National Action Plan (2021-2025), and an emerging National Database on Trafficking in Persons-yet outcomes remain almost uniformly poor: a national gender-based violence (GBV) conviction rate near 5%, and provincial data showing zero convictions across hundreds of rape and domestic-violence cases. This article synthesizes legal-doctrinal scholarship, institutional criminal-justice research, primary government and UN monitoring data, and journalistic incident data to ask how gendered institutional practice-rather than the adequacy of the law alone-shapes whether trafficking cases involving GBV are identified, evidenced, and progressed through Pakistan's criminal justice system. Drawing on Feminist Institutionalism and Street-Level Bureaucracy theory, the article traces an institutional attrition pathway from report to outcome, and shows that the single largest predictor of conviction is not the strength of evidence but which statute a case happens to be prosecuted under: cases routed through the Pakistan Penal Code achieve a 1.2% conviction rate, while functionally similar cases prosecuted under the PTPA achieve 37.8%. The article argues that this statutory-routing effect is itself a gendered institutional practice, shaped by frontline discretion operating under resource constraint, and identifies a concrete research and policy gap at the intersection of gendered victimization, evidence generation, and inter-agency coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究巴基斯坦打击人口贩运法律体系（2018年反人口贩运法、2021-2025国家行动计划及国家数据库）与现实执法结果之间的巨大落差，发现定罪率的主要预测因子不是证据强度，而是案件适用的法律条文（刑法典定罪率仅1.2%，反人口贩运法达37.8%），并论证这一"法条路径效应"本质上是由资源约束下的基层自由裁量权所塑造的性别化制度实践。
AI.research_question: 性别化的制度实践——而非法律本身的充分性——如何影响巴基斯坦刑事司法系统中涉性别暴力的人口贩运案件的识别、取证和推进过程？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦已建立日益复杂的人口贩运应对法律框架（2018年反人口贩运法案、2021-2025国家行动计划、国家数据库），但执法结果几乎普遍糟糕：全国性别暴力定罪率仅约5%，省级数据显示数百起强奸和家庭暴力案件零定罪，表明单靠法律进步无法解决系统性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性主义制度主义（Feminist Institutionalism）与街道层级官僚理论（Street-Level Bureaucracy）
AI.method: 综合法律-教义学研究、机构刑事司法研究、政府与联合国监督数据、新闻报道事件数据，追踪从报案到结果的制度性流失路径。
AI.findings: 定罪与否的最大预测因子不是证据强度而是案件适用的法规：适用巴基斯坦刑法典的案件定罪率仅1.2%，而功能相似但适用反人口贩运法的案件定罪率达37.8%；这一法条路径效应是资源约束下基层自由裁量权塑造的性别化制度实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"法条路径效应"概念化为性别化制度实践，揭示法规选择本身构成性别不平等的制度机制，拓展了女性主义制度主义对制度实践中性别偏见形成机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出性别化受害者、证据生成和跨机构协调交汇处的具体研究和政策空白，为巴基斯坦乃至类似发展中国家的刑事司法改革提供针对性政策切入点。

title: The Interior Cap: Partial Caps and the Residual Read

detail.title: The Interior Cap: Partial Caps and the Residual Read
detail.abstract: Emphasis regimes in audit reporting let the profession select which matters to examine closely, and standards name no number: reports carry a handful drawn from a much longer list. A companion paper showed that such regimes inform only because emphasis is scarce, but its cap was binary-one matter, or all of them. This paper opens the interval between, which two attributes cannot represent, and finds the cap worth more as a quantity than as a switch. One relation organises the results: the cap and the due-care defense are complements, rationing being worthless where courts credit nothing and decisive where they credit everything. At full credit a partial cap does not die. What survives has a closed form-the liability read collapses to α times the squared maximum over the uncovered coordinates, exactly, free of the instance, of the number of attributes, and of the cap itself-so amnesty requires either free coverage or weakest-link doctrine, the honest burden is exactly linear in the doctrine, and what stays legible about a profession is the image of the competence it declined to advertise. Free coverage, meanwhile, is never uniquely best at telling candid firms from evasive ones; where the best cap is unique it is always interior, and the interior cap also makes its labels more expensive to forge. Choosing what to emphasise turns out to be choosing which coordinate answers: a best pair need not contain the best single item, because a set can relocate the binding coordinate where a singleton can only shield it-an effect specific to doctrines that price the extremes of a capability profile, and absent wherever the whole profile is read. The design claim inverts the companion's exclusivity rule, under which a regime could credit generously or let senders file freely but not both: with an interior cap the two coexist, because the regime still prices what was left out. Rationing is what makes generosity affordable.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了审计报告中强调制度（emphasis regimes）的研究，将此前二元（要么一件、要么全部）的强调数量上限拓展为连续区间，发现强调上限作为数量比作为开关更有价值。核心关系是：强调上限与尽职抗辩（due-care defense）是互补品——在法院完全不认可时配给无价值，完全认可时起决定性作用。即使在完全认可下，部分上限依然有效，且责任公式有闭合解。自由覆盖从不是区分诚实与规避型事务所的唯一最优策略；最优上限若唯一则必为内部解。最佳强调组合未必包含最佳单项，因为集合可以转移约束坐标。设计主张推翻了姊妹篇的排他性规则：内部上限允许慷慨认可与自由呈报并存，配给正是慷慨可负担的原因。
AI.research_question: 审计报告中强调制度的上限作为数量（而非二元开关）时，其最优设计是什么？强调上限与尽职抗辩之间的互补关系如何影响责任配置和信号传递？
AI.motivation: 姊妹篇论文将强调上限设定为二元的（一件或全部），无法刻画现实中介于两者之间的情形。审计报告通常从较长的清单中精选少数事项，而两个属性（二元上限）无法充分表征这一区间内的设计问题，本文旨在打开这一未被研究的中间区间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强调制度（emphasis regimes）理论、信号传递理论、尽职抗辩（due-care defense）理论、配给（rationing）机制设计
AI.method: 数理模型分析，通过闭合形式求解责任函数，比较二元上限与连续上限（内部上限）下的均衡与最优设计。
AI.findings: （1）上限与尽职抗辩是互补品：法院不认可时配给无价值，完全认可时起决定性作用；（2）完全认可下部分上限不失效，责任公式闭合解为α乘以未覆盖坐标平方最大值，与实例、属性数量和上限本身无关；（3）自由覆盖从不是唯一最优的信号区分策略；（4）最优上限唯一时必为内部解，且内部上限使标签更难伪造；（5）最佳强调组合未必包含最佳单项，集合可转移约束坐标而单项只能屏蔽它——此效应仅在定价能力极限的学说下存在；（6）内部上限使慷慨认可与自由呈报可以共存，推翻了姊妹篇的排他性规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文从理论上将强调制度的上限从二元拓展为连续区间，揭示了上限作为数量与作为开关的本质区别；建立了上限与尽职抗辩之间的互补关系理论；发现了"最佳集合未必包含最佳单项"的坐标转移效应及其学说条件；推翻了姊妹篇的排他性规则，证明了"配给使慷慨可负担"的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计准则制定者提供最优强调上限设计的理论指导；解释了为什么在法院高度认可尽职抗辩的司法环境中，部分上限依然有效且最优；为区分诚实型与规避型事务所提供信号设计启示；说明专业声誉的"可读性"源于其拒绝宣传的能力。

title: Emission reduction pathway optimization and comprehensive benefit assessment in the Pearl River Delta based on a deep learning response surface model
affiliations: Jinan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Jinan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and South China University of Technology

detail.title: Emission reduction pathway optimization and comprehensive benefit assessment in the Pearl River Delta based on a deep learning response surface model
detail.abstract: Despite intensified mitigation efforts, ozone (O3) concentrations in the Pearl River Delta (PRD) remain volatile and prone to rebounding, posing persistent risks to public health and agricultural ecosystems. Using a 2023 baseline emission inventory and a 3% regional O3 reduction target grounded in recent volatility trends, this study constructed an optimization framework integrating a deep learning-based response surface model, a genetic algorithm, and marginal abatement cost curves to minimize total societal emission reduction costs. The optimal synergistic pathway requires average NOx and VOCs reductions of 18.9% and 20.0%, respectively, achieving a 3.6%-4.1% O3 decline at a total cost of 0.83 billion CNY, with a benefit-cost ratio (BCR) of 7.6. BCRs varied substantially across cities, ranging from 1.3 to 35.0, underscoring the need for phased, city-differentiated emission reduction policies. This pathway can avoid 1,196 premature deaths during the 2023 warm season (95% UI: 582-1943) and significantly improve spatial and socioeconomic equity, indicated by a 10% decrease in the O3 exposure Gini coefficient and a 21.4% reduction in the absolute value of the health burden concentration index. In addition, the optimal pathway reduces O3-induced crop yield losses and avoids more than 20 million CNY in direct agricultural economic losses. This study provides a quantitative scientific basis for precise and coordinated O3 control in the PRD and offers a transferable technical approach for air quality management in other key regions of China.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2023年基准排放清单和3%的区域臭氧削减目标，构建了集成深度学习响应面模型、遗传算法和边际减排成本曲线的优化框架，以最小化社会总减排成本。最优协同路径要求平均NOx和VOCs分别削减18.9%和20.0%，实现3.6%-4.1%的臭氧下降，总成本8.3亿元，收益成本比为7.6。该路径可避免1196例过早死亡，改善时空和社会经济公平性，并减少超过2000万元的农业经济损失。
AI.research_question: 在珠三角地区臭氧浓度波动且易反弹的背景下，如何设计成本最优的NOx和VOCs协同减排路径，以实现在改善公共健康、农业生态和社会公平性的同时达成区域臭氧削减目标？
AI.motivation: 尽管强化了减排努力，珠三角地区的臭氧浓度仍然波动且容易反弹，对公共健康和农业生态系统构成持续风险。现有研究缺乏将成本最小化、健康效益、公平性和农业影响整合于一体的臭氧协同控制优化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习响应面模型（用于模拟臭氧对前体物的非线性响应）、遗传算法（用于优化搜索）、边际减排成本曲线（用于量化减排成本）的成本效益分析框架，并结合环境公平理论（Gini系数和健康负担集中指数）进行评估。
AI.method: 整合深度学习响应面模型、遗传算法与边际减排成本曲线，构建多目标优化框架；以2023年基准排放清单和3%区域臭氧削减目标为约束，最小化社会总减排成本；通过收益成本比（BCR）、Gini系数、健康负担集中指数和农业经济损失评估路径的综合效益。
AI.findings: 最优协同路径需NOx和VOCs分别削减18.9%和20.0%，实现3.6%-4.1%的臭氧下降，总成本8.3亿元，BCR为7.6；各城市BCR差异大（1.3-35.0），需分阶段差异化减排；可避免1196例过早死亡，臭氧暴露Gini系数降低10%，健康负担集中指数绝对值降低21.4%，并避免超过2000万元的直接农业经济损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了将深度学习响应面模型、遗传算法与边际减排成本曲线集成于一体的臭氧控制优化框架，为非线性空气污染响应下的成本效益分析提供了方法论创新；将环境公平（Gini系数和集中指数）定量纳入空气质量优化决策框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为珠三角地区提供了精准、协调的臭氧控制定量科学依据，明确了各城市差异化的NOx与VOCs协同减排路径及成本效益；为其他中国重点区域的空气质量管理提供了可转移的技术方法和政策参考。

title: Market Intermediaries and the Green Transition: Evidence on Stock Exchanges and Bank Green Finance Adoption in Emerging Markets

detail.title: Market Intermediaries and the Green Transition: Evidence on Stock Exchanges and Bank Green Finance Adoption in Emerging Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or non-financial interests, direct or indirect, related to the work submitted for publication. On behalf of all authors, the corresponding author confirms there is no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study drew on secondary data from publicly available sources and primary data collected through a structured questionnaire administered to financial practitioners. The research protocol was reviewed and approved by the School of Business and Law Research Ethics Review Panel (RERP) at London Metropolitan University, in accordance with the university's Research Ethics Policy and Procedures and the Code of Good Research Practice, and in compliance with the 1964 Declaration of Helsinki and its later amendments. No reference number was issued by the committee. Participation was voluntary and anonymous, and informed written consent was obtained from all participants prior to data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: No funds, grants, or other support were received during the preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: The global transition from traditional to sustainable finance has become increasingly urgent as climate change accelerates, regulatory pressure intensifies, and biodiversity loss threatens developing economies. Despite growing momentum in green finance, banking sector adoption remains fragmented, constrained by inconsistent regulatory frameworks, limited market transparency, and weak incentive structures, particularly in low and middle-income economies. Stock exchanges are increasingly positioned as pivotal intermediaries capable of bridging this gap, however, their specific role remains insufficiently examined. This study investigates how stock exchanges can promote green finance adoption by banks globally through mixed-methods analysis synthesising 64 sources and primary data collected from financial practitioners. Four interdependent drivers of adoption are identified: market regulations, market mechanisms, awareness, and incentives. Notably, data from the International Monetary Fund and the International Organization of Securities Commissions confirm that only 49% of regulators in low-income economies maintain supportive market regulations, compared with 85% in high-income OECD nations. These findings indicate that stock exchanges must transition from voluntary guidance to binding frameworks mandating Environmental, Social and Governance disclosure and green bond standards for listed banks, supported by targeted tax incentives, formalised peer exchange partnerships, and standardised disclosure in carbon markets to direct capital toward achieving net-zero by 2050.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法分析64个来源及金融从业者的一手数据，探讨证券交易所如何促进银行在全球范围内采纳绿色金融。识别出市场法规、市场机制、意识与激励四个相互依赖的采纳驱动因素，并发现低收入经济体监管支持率（49%）远低于高收入OECD国家（85%），建议交易所从自愿指引转向约束性框架以推动净零目标。
AI.research_question: 证券交易所如何促进银行在全球范围内采纳绿色金融？
AI.motivation: 绿色金融虽在加速发展，但银行业采纳仍碎片化，受制于监管框架不一致、市场透明度有限和激励结构薄弱，尤其在低收入和中等收入经济体。证券交易所被视为弥合这一差距的关键中介，但其具体角色尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究识别出四个相互依赖的绿色金融采纳驱动因素：市场法规（market regulations）、市场机制（market mechanisms）、意识（awareness）和激励（incentives）。
AI.method: 混合方法分析（mixed-methods analysis），综合64个来源的文献数据，并结合从金融从业者处收集的一手数据；同时引用了国际货币基金组织（IMF）和国际证监会组织（IOSCO）的监管数据。
AI.findings: （1）识别出市场法规、市场机制、意识和激励四个相互依赖的采纳驱动因素；（2）低收入经济体仅有49%的监管机构维持支持性市场法规，而高收入OECD国家为85%；（3）证券交易所需从自愿指引转向约束性框架，包括强制ESG披露、绿色债券标准、定向税收激励、正式的同行交流伙伴关系以及碳市场标准化披露。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了证券交易所作为中介机构在促进银行绿色金融采纳中具体角色的研究空白，提出了四个相互依赖的采纳驱动因素框架，深化了对可持续金融转型机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为证券交易所、政策制定者和监管机构提供了可操作的政策建议，包括从自愿指引转向约束性框架、建立强制ESG披露与绿色债券标准、设计税收激励与同行合作机制，以推动资本流向2050年净零目标。

title:
Mitigating the Pollution-climate Feedback Loop in a Polycrisis System: 
Macroeconomic, Thermodynamic, and Network-Systems Strategies for Breaking Re inforcing Environmental Cycles

detail.title:
Mitigating the Pollution-climate Feedback Loop in a Polycrisis System: 
Macroeconomic, Thermodynamic, and Network-Systems Strategies for Breaking Re inforcing Environmental Cycles
detail.abstract:
The report argues that modern environmental destabilization emerges from a tightly coupled Pollution‑Climate Feedback Loop operating inside a global polycrisis, where toxic pollutants, atmospheric thermodynamics, biophysical tipping cascades, and macro‑financial fragility reinforce one another. As the document states, “industrial pollution exacerbates climate disruption, and climate disruption in turn intensifies the toxicity… and economic burden of environmental pollutants” . Conventional climate models and policy frameworks fail because they treat CO₂, air pollution, and macroeconomic stability as separate domains, ignoring non‑linear amplification across atmospheric chemistry, boundary‑layer dynamics, wildfire aerosols, labor productivity, and sovereign debt markets.

The study synthesizes non‑equilibrium thermodynamics, multiplex network theory, and strategic macro‑finance to show how second‑law exergy destruction, aerosol masking, ozone‑driven vegetation dieback, and wildfire black‑carbon cascades create reinforcing loops that multiply damages far beyond standard IAM projections. As the report notes, “over 72% of all primary energy extracted is destroyed as unusable waste exergy… discharged as disordered, chemically reactive pollutants” . This thermodynamic inefficiency feeds boundary‑layer stagnation, urban heat traps, and atmospheric chemistry that intensifies warming.

To break these cycles, the report proposes a three‑pillar intervention architecture: (1) fast‑track abatement of short‑lived climate pollutants (SLCPs) to avoid aerosol‑termination warming shocks; (2) closed‑loop industrial exergy cascading and radiative sky cooling to reduce waste‑heat forcing; and (3) macro‑financial restructuring—including dual‑rate green refinancing and multilateral de‑risking—to compress emerging‑market WACC and unlock clean‑infrastructure investment. Coordinated implementation averts trillions in projected GDP losses and prevents the system from locking into high‑entropy, fossil‑dependent trajectories.

AI.tldr: 该报告指出现代环境失衡源于一个紧密耦合的"污染-气候反馈回路"，该回路在全球多重危机中运行，使有毒污染物、大气热力学、生物物理临界级联和宏观金融脆弱性相互强化。传统气候模型和政策框架因将CO₂、空气污染和宏观经济稳定视为分离领域而失效。研究整合非平衡热力学、多重网络理论和战略宏观金融，提出三支柱干预架构：快速消减短期气候污染物、闭环工业㶲级联与辐射天空冷却、以及宏观金融重组。
AI.research_question: 污染与气候之间的反馈回路如何在全球多重危机中形成非线性放大效应，以及如何设计有效的干预架构来打破这些恶性循环？
AI.motivation: 传统气候模型和政策框架将CO₂、空气污染和宏观经济稳定视为独立领域，忽视了大气化学、边界层动力学、野火气溶胶、劳动生产率与主权债务市场之间的非线性放大机制，导致严重低估了环境破坏的经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非平衡热力学（第二定律㶲破坏）、多重网络理论、战略宏观金融
AI.method: 综合理论合成方法，整合热力学分析、多重网络建模和宏观金融分析，识别污染-气候反馈回路中的非线性放大机制，并设计三支柱干预架构。
AI.findings: 超过72%的一次能源被转化为无用的废㶲并以无序、化学活性污染物的形式排放；这些热力学低效驱动边界层停滞、城市热阱和加剧升温的大气化学过程；污染-气候反馈回路造成的损害远超标准IAM预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将非平衡热力学、多重网络理论与战略宏观金融整合，揭示污染-气候反馈回路中第二定律㶲破坏、气溶胶遮蔽效应、臭氧驱动的植被退化与野火黑碳级联如何形成强化回路，挑战传统IAM模型的线性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三支柱干预架构：快速消减短期气候污染物以避免气溶胶终止升温冲击；闭环工业㶲级联与辐射天空冷却以减少废热强迫；宏观金融重组（双轨绿色再融资与多边去风险化）以压缩新兴市场WACC并释放清洁基础设施投资。协调实施可避免数万亿美元GDP损失。

title: Green Gold: Avocado Production and Conflict in Mexico

detail.title: Green Gold: Avocado Production and Conflict in Mexico
detail.abstract: The surge in global demand for Mexican avocados, particularly from the United States, has led to increased production and revenue in avocado-producing municipalities of Mexico. I show that these external changes in avocado global consumption patterns have influenced conflict levels in Mexico. Combining geographical variations in avocado cultivation suitability and fluctuations in avocado demand over time, I find a notable rise in homicides among agricultural workers in municipalities that are well-suited for avocado production. I demonstrate that this rise in homicides is not explained by the increased presence of drug cartels but rather heightened competition between cartels for resources in municipalities where avocados are produced. These findings suggest that cartels vie for territorial control, diversifying their income sources, including the avocado industry, in response to their relatively limited influence over drug markets and routes.

AI.tldr: 全球对墨西哥牛油果需求激增（尤其来自美国）导致墨西哥牛油果产区收入增加，但同时也加剧了该地区的暴力冲突。研究发现，在适合牛油果种植的市镇，农业工人的凶杀率显著上升，原因并非贩毒集团的增加，而是贩毒集团之间为争夺牛油果产业资源而展开的激烈竞争。这些集团为应对其在毒品市场和路线上的相对有限影响力，转而争夺领土控制并多元化收入来源，包括涉足牛油果产业。
AI.research_question: 外部全球牛油果消费需求变化如何影响墨西哥的冲突水平？具体而言，牛油果需求的增长是否以及在何种机制下导致牛油果产区暴力事件增加？
AI.motivation: 全球对墨西哥牛油果（尤其来自美国）的需求激增，虽然促进了产区的生产和收入增长，但可能带来未预期的社会冲突后果。理解合法农产品出口需求对地方暴力冲突的影响，对于政策制定和冲突治理具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济冲击与冲突关系的理论框架，结合贩毒集团行为理论的多元化收入来源与领土竞争逻辑，分析合法商品需求冲击如何通过影响犯罪组织的资源竞争格局而影响地方暴力水平。
AI.method: 利用牛油果种植适宜性的地理差异与牛油果需求随时间波动的双重变化，构建差异中的差异（difference-in-differences）识别策略，对墨西哥市镇层面的凶杀数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 在适合牛油果生产的市镇，农业工人的凶杀率显著上升；这一上升并非由贩毒集团数量增加所致，而是由贩毒集团之间为争夺牛油果产区资源而展开的竞争加剧所驱动。贩毒集团在毒品市场影响力受限的情况下，转向争夺领土控制并多元化收入来源，包括进入牛油果产业。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了合法经济冲击与冲突之间关系的理论理解，揭示合法商品需求激增如何通过改变犯罪组织的竞争动态而非直接增加其存在来影响暴力水平；丰富了关于犯罪组织行为多元化和收入来源多样化策略的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于农产品出口繁荣可能带来的安全风险的证据，提示在促进合法农业发展时需配套冲突预防和治理措施；对理解全球供应链如何影响地方安全局势具有参考价值。

title: Federated Big Data Processing in Multi-Cloud Architectures
affiliations: ,  Tata Consultancy Services, Unaffiliated Authors, Elevance Health, Inc. and Unaffiliated Authors

detail.title: Federated Big Data Processing in Multi-Cloud Architectures
detail.abstract: The accelerated pace of big data and the resulting spread of distributed applications have led to the requirement of scalable, secure, and efficient data processing platforms in the heterogeneous cloud environment. Federated big data processing on multi-clouds is a promising paradigm that can overcome the problems of data sovereignty, interoperability and performance optimization. This paper proposes a holistic view of how federated processing pipelines can be designed, which would allow multiple cloud service providers to collaborate seamlessly and maintain data locality, compliance, and resiliency. The suggested architecture uses the principles of containerization, orchestration, and federated learning to reduce communication overhead and streamline the use of resources across clouds. In addition, security-enhancing protocols like policy-driven access controls, differentiation privacy, and homomorphic encryption are incorporated to protect sensitive data when processing inter-clouds. Scalability, fault tolerance, query responsiveness, and other experimental results have been shown to greatly improve over traditional single-cloud solutions. The results indicate that federated multiclouds can provide the backbone to the next generation of big data applications in finance, healthcare, and smart cities, where data diversity, security, and compliance are of utmost importance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向多云环境的联邦式大数据处理架构，通过容器化、编排和联邦学习等技术实现跨云协作，并融入策略驱动访问控制、差分隐私和同态加密等安全协议，实验证明其在可扩展性、容错性和查询响应等方面优于传统单云方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在异构多云环境中设计一个可扩展、安全且高效的联邦式大数据处理架构，以克服数据主权、互操作性和性能优化等问题？
AI.motivation: 大数据时代的加速发展导致分布式应用激增，传统单云方案在数据主权、互操作性和资源优化方面存在不足，亟需一种能够支持多云协作的联邦式数据处理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦学习理论、容器化与编排技术原理、安全多方计算理论（差分隐私、同态加密）、分布式系统容错与可扩展性理论。
AI.method: 提出一种联邦式大数据处理管道的整体架构设计，采用容器化与编排技术实现跨云资源管理，结合联邦学习降低通信开销，并集成策略驱动访问控制、差分隐私和同态加密等安全协议；通过实验对比联邦多云方案与传统单云方案的性能。
AI.findings: 实验结果表明，所提出的联邦式多云架构在可扩展性、容错性、查询响应速度等方面显著优于传统单云解决方案，能够为金融、医疗和智慧城市等对数据安全与合规有高要求的应用提供基础支撑。
AI.theory_contributions: 为联邦式多云大数据处理提供了一套系统性的架构设计框架，将容器化、联邦学习与多种安全协议进行有机结合，丰富了多云协作处理的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多云云服务商之间的无缝协作提供了可行的实施方案，帮助企业在金融、医疗、智慧城市等领域实现数据本地化、合规性和弹性的兼顾，同时降低通信开销并提升资源利用效率。

title: The Indivisibility of Option Replication and Portfolio Theory: Uncovering the Mechanics of the Moore Option Pricing Model in the Second Loop
affiliations: University of Toledo

detail.title: The Indivisibility of Option Replication and Portfolio Theory: Uncovering the Mechanics of the Moore Option Pricing Model in the Second Loop

keywords: Financial Economics Working Paper Series JEL Classification: G12 (Asset Pricing)

detail.abstract: This paper provides an empirical and theoretical re-examination of options crosssectional pricing by demonstrating that the options surface can be systematically modeled as a log-linear weighted portfolio rate asset in the Moore Option Pricing Model. The model is a variable drift Fokker-Planck derived pricing model that solves the basic Black-Scholes model for the interest rate with a solved unity optimal variance. Rather than treating contingent claims as speculative black boxes requiring strike-specific variance parameters, our framework demonstrates that the contract cross-section is fully explained by a native, natural log-additive two-component vector field: an active leverage-constrained equity replication leg and a continuous probabilistic boundary funding constraint. Testing the matrix against the canonical January 2, 1990 S&P 500 Index options dataset yields outstanding empirical results. The model solves a single, perfectly uniform implied stock return parameter (21.01%) across the entire contract chain, establishing a strict, structure-preserving compositional isomorphism. Passing our extracted uniform drift field backward through the static replication weights reconstructs the entire sixteen-strike premium vector back to the penny, confirming that the no-intercept layout triggers a flawless bidirectional identity that handles microscopic market friction effortlessly, deflating transaction noise down to a minor 14-cent residual ripple per contract. This absolute cross-sectional coherence provides definitive proof that portfolio theory integrates flawlessly with this classic solution trace, resolving much of the multi-decade mystery of derivative pricing by dissolving the MacBeth-Merville (1979) spatial decay and the post-1987 volatility smile by identity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出摩尔期权定价模型（Moore Option Pricing Model），将期权截面定价重新概念化为一个对数线性加权组合收益率资产。通过变漂移Fokker-Planck定价模型，在1990年1月2日S&P 500指数期权数据集上实现了整个期权链的完美横截面一致性，单一路径漂移参数（21.01%）即可重建全部十六个行权价的期权价格，误差仅14美分。
AI.research_question: 期权横截面定价能否用一个统一的、非行权价特定的参数框架来系统化建模？传统的Black-Scholes模型及后续波动率微笑现象是否可以被更根本的理论架构所消解？
AI.motivation: 传统期权定价依赖行权价特定的波动率参数（如波动率微笑），缺乏统一的横截面解释。作者试图通过理论和实证两个层面，证明期权曲面可以被建模为一个对数线性加权组合收益率资产，从而解决衍生品定价中长期存在的谜团。
AI.theoretical_framework: 摩尔期权定价模型（Moore Option Pricing Model）；变漂移Fokker-Planck定价模型；Black-Scholes模型框架（针对利率求解并设定单位最优方差）；对数可加双分量向量场理论；组合复制与静态复制权重理论；结构保持组合同构（compositional isomorphism）。
AI.method: 理论推导建立变漂移Fokker-Planck定价模型，将期权合约截面分解为两个自然对数可加的分量：活跃的杠杆约束股权复制腿和连续概率边界资金约束。然后使用1990年1月2日S&P 500指数期权数据集（16个行权价）进行实证检验，通过提取统一漂移参数并反向通过静态复制权重重建期权价格向量来验证模型一致性。
AI.findings: 模型在全部合约链上求解出一个完全统一的隐含股票收益率参数（21.01%）；提取的均匀漂移场通过静态复制权重反向重建可精确还原整个十六行权价期权价格向量至分币级别；每份合约交易噪声仅14美分的残差波纹；该模型通过恒等式消解了MacBeth-Merville（1979）空间衰减和1987年后出现的波动率微笑现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出摩尔期权定价模型，将期权定价从投机性黑箱（需要行权价特定波动率参数）转变为对数线性加权组合收益率资产框架；建立了结构保持的组合同构（compositional isomorphism）；通过恒等式而非经验修正解决了波动率微笑和期权截面定价的长期理论难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权市场参与者提供了一种统一的定价框架，无需针对每个行权价估计单独的波动率参数；精确到分币的定价能力可显著降低定价误差和交易成本；提供了处理市场微观摩擦的有效方式，将交易噪声压缩到极低水平。

title: Planetary Cooling Pathways: Scientific Scenarios for Returning to a Stable Climate State

detail.title: Planetary Cooling Pathways: Scientific Scenarios for Returning to a Stable Climate State
detail.abstract:
Humanity has entered a dangerous climate overshoot regime in which achieving net‑zero emissions is no longer sufficient to restore Earth system stability. As the report states, “net‑zero halts additional greenhouse gas radiative forcing, but it stabilizes global temperatures at an elevated, dangerous plateau” . Even with full decarbonization, ocean thermal inertia, cryosphere disintegration, and carbon cycle hysteresis lock in centuries of warming and tipping‑element activation.

This research develops a century‑scale scientific architecture for Planetary Cooling—the intentional reduction of global mean surface temperature back toward the Holocene stability envelope (<1.0 °C, ~350 ppm CO₂). The analysis integrates Earth’s Energy Imbalance dynamics, ocean heat persistence, carbon cycle hysteresis, and multi‑vector interventions across both longwave and shortwave radiative pathways.

The core conclusion is that meaningful cooling within 50–100 years requires a Two‑Pronged Planetary Architecture:

  1. Gigatonne‑Scale Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) delivering 15–22 Gt CO₂/yr by 2060–2080 through DACCS, Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement, Enhanced Rock Weathering, and biochar. This longwave restoration permanently reduces greenhouse forcing but operates on decadal–century timescales.

  2. Temporary Solar Radiation Modification (SRM)—specifically multi‑latitude Stratospheric Aerosol Injection or Marine Cloud Brightening—to “shave” 0.5–0.8 °C of peak warming and prevent irreversible tipping‑element collapse while CDR scales. As the report notes, “SAI must never be deployed without binding, scaled CDR deployment” due to termination‑shock risks .

The report outlines a four‑phase planetary cooling timeline (2026–2100), governance requirements under a UN Planetary Cooling Oversight Council, and macroeconomic valuation showing >3.5:1 benefit‑cost ratios for structural CDR and >300:1 for SRM peak‑shaving.

Overall, the document argues that planetary cooling is not optional but physically required to avoid irreversible cryosphere loss, AMOC collapse, and multi‑system tipping cascades. It reframes climate action from “stopping warming” to actively restoring Earth’s radiative balance and long‑term habitability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"行星冷却"（Planetary Cooling）的世纪尺度科学架构，主张在净零排放已不足以恢复地球系统稳定性的气候过冲（overshoot）时代，需要通过两大支柱协同干预：15-22 Gt CO₂/年规模的Gt级碳移除（CDR）以恢复长波辐射平衡，以及临时的太阳辐射管理（SRM）以削减0.5-0.8°C峰值升温、防止临界元素崩塌。研究勾勒了2026-2100四阶段冷却时间线、联合国行星冷却监督委员会的治理框架，并给出了CDR >3.5:1和SRM >300:1的效益成本比评估，将气候行动从"停止升温"重新定义为"主动恢复地球辐射平衡与长期宜居性"。
AI.research_question: 在净零排放已不足以恢复地球系统稳定性的气候过冲时代，如何通过战略性的行星冷却架构在50-100年时间尺度内有意义地将全球平均地表温度降回全新世稳定包络线（<1.0°C，~350 ppm CO₂）？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球推进净零排放，但海洋热惯性、冰冻圈瓦解和碳循环滞后效应将导致全球气温在升高且危险的高原上稳定数百年，并触发临界元素激活。因此，仅仅"停止升温"已不够，需要主动降温以恢复地球系统稳定性和长期宜居性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地球能量失衡（Earth's Energy Imbalance）动力学、海洋热量持久性、碳循环滞后效应（carbon cycle hysteresis）、长波与短波辐射路径的多向量干预理论，以及临界元素（tipping elements）级联理论。
AI.method: 本研究采用跨世纪的综合科学架构分析方法，整合地球能量失衡动力学、海洋热持久性、碳循环滞后和多向量干预方案（覆盖长波和短波辐射路径），构建了2026-2100年四阶段行星冷却时间线，并进行宏观经济效益成本分析（benefit-cost ratio评估）。
AI.findings: （1）在50-100年内实现有意义的降温需要双管齐下的行星架构：Gt级CDR（15-22 Gt CO₂/yr，通过DACCS、海洋碱度增强、增强岩石风化和生物炭实现）提供永久性长波恢复；临时SRM（多纬度平流层气溶胶注入或海洋云增亮）削减0.5-0.8°C峰值升温并防止不可逆临界元素崩塌。（2）CDR的结构性效益成本比>3.5:1，SRM峰值削减的效益成本比>300:1。（3）行星冷却是物理上必需的，而非可选的，以避免不可逆的冰冻圈损失、AMOC崩塌和多系统临界级联。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次将气候行动从"停止升温"（net-zero范式）重新概念化为"主动恢复地球辐射平衡"的行星冷却范式，整合了长波（CDR）和短波（SRM）双路径干预理论，并提出了将临时SRM与绑定CDR部署相结合以防止终止冲击（termination shock）风险的新治理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的行星冷却实施蓝图：四阶段时间线（2026-2100）、两个支柱的技术组合方案及量化目标（CDR 15-22 Gt CO₂/yr、SRM削减0.5-0.8°C）、联合国行星冷却监督委员会的治理架构建议，以及宏观经济可行性论证（CDR >3.5:1和SRM >300:1的效益成本比），为政策制定者和国际治理机构提供了可操作的行动指南。

title: Affective Equity and Evidentiary Legibility
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Affective Equity and Evidentiary Legibility
detail.abstract: AIVO's prior work (WP-2026-14, the Linkage Gap) established that AI systems cite a brand and then recommend a competitor 87.3 percent of the time across a corpus of more than 12,500 multi-turn purchase decision probes spanning 68 brands. That finding establishes that citation and recommendation are separable outcomes. It does not explain which brands are protected from displacement and which are not. This paper proposes that the explanation lies in a distinction between two forms of brand strength that are commonly treated as one. Affective Equity is the human-facing construct: sensory association, emotional memory, distinctive assets, and narrative resonance, the territory of classical brand equity theory. Evidentiary Legibility is the AI-facing construct: the density and structure of third-party-verifiable, attribute-level content available to an AI system evaluating a purchase decision. We hypothesize that Affective Equity predicts whether a brand is cited, consistent with recent third-party findings that longterm brand equity explains the majority of AI visibility, but that it does not predict whether a brand survives to become the final recommendation. We hypothesize that Evidentiary Legibility does predict survival, independent of Affective Equity, and that the Linkage Gap is concentrated among brands that are high on the former and low on the latter. We propose a method for testing this against AIVO's existing probe corpus and outline the construction of a new instrument, an Evidentiary Legibility score, required to run the analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将品牌强度区分为"情感资产"（人类向）与"证据可读性"（AI向）两个维度，用以解释AI系统中"引用品牌却推荐竞品"（Linkage Gap）的分布差异，并设计了一个新的测量工具来验证假设。
AI.research_question: 哪些品牌在AI推荐系统中能免于被"引用后替换"（Linkage Gap），哪些不能？其决定性因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 前期研究（WP-2026-14）发现AI系统87.3%的情况下引用品牌却推荐竞品，证明引用与推荐是可分离的结果，但未解释哪些品牌受到保护、哪些不受保护。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典品牌资产理论（情感资产）与新兴的AI向品牌可见性理论（证据可读性）的双维框架。
AI.method: 提出基于AIVO既有12,500+多轮购买决策探针语料的检验方法，并构建新的"证据可读性"评分工具。
AI.findings: 假设：情感资产预测品牌是否被引用，但不预测是否成为最终推荐；证据可读性独立于情感资产预测品牌存活至最终推荐；Linkage Gap集中于高情感资产、低证据可读性的品牌。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将品牌强度的两个维度（人类向与AI向）加以区分，为理解AI推荐系统中的品牌可见性机制提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供可操作的诊断工具（证据可读性评分），帮助品牌在AI推荐环境中识别和弥补自身弱点。

title: Medical Receivables as Counterparty Credit Risk: A Credibility-Theoretic Framework with a Calibration Gate

detail.title: Medical Receivables as Counterparty Credit Risk: A Credibility-Theoretic Framework with a Calibration Gate

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a principal of a technology firm that develops receivables-analytics tooling for revenue-cycle clients, and therefore has a commercial interest in the asset class discussed. No client or proprietary data is used in this paper; all quantitative content is closed-form theory or fully synthetic simulation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable: the paper involves no human participants and no patient data. All quantitative content is derived mathematically or generated by a seeded synthetic simulation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Medical receivables are conventionally managed as an operational-recovery problem: claims are worked by staff against denial-reason playbooks, and performance is measured as a recovery rate. This paper develops the theory of an alternative classification — a receivable is an exposure to an adjudicating counterparty — and derives what the classification makes decidable. Four sets of results. First, a two-level model of a claims book in which payer-level denial propensities carry the risk; the credibility estimator for a payer's propensity is derived from first principles, with shrinkage weight n_j/(n_j + m) and m = E[θ(1−θ)]/Var(θ), and the classical limited-fluctuation full-credibility standard is shown to reappear, exactly, as the refusal branch of the paper's speech-licensing gate. Second, the counterparty concentration hypothesis — claim-level features carry no outcome information conditional on payer identity — is formalized, and its testable signature proved: under the hypothesis the payer-only optimum attains the full-information optimum, so the population AUC gap is exactly zero; an exact pair decomposition shows what the finite-sample ablation can and cannot detect. Third, a calibration gate for validation: the volume inequality n ≥ p̂(1−p̂)(z/ε)², a turndown floor n_T = z²(1−p̂)/(γ²p̂) — the classical full-credibility standard redeployed as a refusal branch — below which the licensed output is refusal rather than a coarser number, an effective-volume rule n_eff = n/(1 + (ñ−1)ρ_ICC) pricing pooled fallback quotes under the model's own intraclass correlation, a push rule requiring the settlement map for multi-valued outcomes to be fixed ex ante (post-hoc settlement leaves the reported rate unidentified within an interval of width equal to the ambiguous mass), and judge–process independence. Fourth, the sharpest result: with payer-period shocks of variance share φ and persistence ρ, one-period-forward discrimination relates to within-period cross-validated discrimination by AUC_fwd ≈ Φ(κ Φ⁻¹(AUC_cv)) with κ = 1−(1−ρ)φ — so K-fold optimism on shock-driven books is structural, surviving correct specification and unlimited data; a companion result gives the Mills-ratio distortion of accepted-region calibration under selective labels. A fully synthetic, seeded simulation confirms each derived curve (the attenuation prediction is accurate to at most 0.021 AUC over a 3 × 5 parameter grid). Empirical validation on proprietary data is preregistered and reported separately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将医疗应收账款视为对裁决方（payer）的风险敞口而非运营回收问题，建立了基于付款人层否认倾向的两层模型，推导出多个可测试的判别结果，包括经验贝叶斯收缩估计量、对手方集中度假设下的AUC间隙性质、校准门控规则，以及关键的前瞻性歧视衰减公式AUC_fwd ≈ Φ(κΦ⁻¹(AUC_cv))，证明K折交叉验证的乐观偏差在冲击驱动的账簿上是结构性的。
AI.research_question: 将医疗应收账款重新分类为对裁决对手方的风险敞口后，这一分类使哪些问题变得可判定？具体而言：付款人层否认倾向如何建模与估计？对手方集中度假设的检验特征是什么？验证校准门控的条件是什么？前向判别能力如何随付款人周期冲击衰减？
AI.motivation: 传统上将医疗应收账款视为运营回收问题（按否认原因手册工作、以回收率衡量绩效），本文认为这一框架掩盖了应收账款的本质——它是对裁决方（payer）的信用风险敞口。重新分类后，许多原本模糊的管理决策变得可判定，包括付款人可信度估计、特征信息的条件价值、验证阈值设定以及前向绩效预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经验贝叶斯收缩估计理论（credibility theory）、经典有限波动完全可信度标准（limited-fluctuation full-credibility standard）、对手方集中度假设（counterparty concentration hypothesis）、类内相关（intraclass correlation）定价模型、选择性标注下的Mills比率校准理论
AI.method: 理论推导为主：从第一性原理推导付款人否认倾向的可信度估计量（收缩权重n_j/(n_j+m)）；正式化对手方集中度假设并证明其AUC间隙为零的特征；推导精确的配对分解；建立校准门控的体积不等式、拒绝下限、有效体积规则；推导前向判别衰减公式AUC_fwd ≈ Φ(κΦ⁻¹(AUC_cv))。辅以全合成种子模拟验证（3×5参数网格上衰减预测精度≤0.021 AUC）。
AI.findings: （1）付款人否认倾向的可信度估计量收缩权重为n_j/(n_j+m)，且经典完全可信度标准精确重现为拒绝分支；（2）对手方集中度假设下付款人最优解达到完全信息最优，总体AUC间隙恰好为零；（3）校准门控包括体积不等式、拒绝下限、有效体积规则和法官-过程独立性要求；（4）关键结果：前向判别与交叉验证判别满足AUC_fwd ≈ Φ(κΦ⁻¹(AUC_cv))，κ=1−(1−ρ)φ，表明K折乐观偏差在正确设定和无限数据下依然结构性存在；选择性标签下接受区域校准存在Mills比率失真。
AI.theory_contributions: 将医疗应收账款从运营问题重新分类为对手方风险敞口问题，为这一分类建立了完整的决策理论体系；将经典有限波动完全可信度标准重新演绎为模型的语言授权门控拒绝分支；证明了对手方集中度假设的可测试特征（AUC间隙为零）；发现了K折交叉验证乐观偏差是结构性的而非模型设定问题的深层理论结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗应收账款管理提供了可操作的判定规则：付款人可信度估计公式（含收缩参数）、何时应拒绝而非输出粗略数字的阈值（拒绝下限）、多值结果的结算映射需事前固定的要求、前向绩效预测公式（可用于资源配置与绩效预期设定）、以及池化回退报价的定价规则。

title: Open Onchain University Vision
affiliations: Anadolu University

detail.title: Open Onchain University Vision
detail.abstract: Open and distance education has expanded access to higher learning for tens of millions of people, yet the evidence of that learning remains institutionally owned, administratively opaque, and difficult to verify across borders. This paper sets out the Open Onchain University (OOU), a design vision for an open, learner-owned credentialing and recognition infrastructure built on decentralized identifiers, verifiable credentials, and learning analytics. The paper is conceptual rather than empirical. It advances an earlier scoping review by the author on smart open education ecosystems (Fırat, 2023) from an account of technological potential to a specifiable infrastructure design, and revises several positions taken there. It develops a set of design principles, a five-layer reference architecture, a governance model, and a staged implementation roadmap, It formalizes the Proof-of-Learning construct as a five-tuple on which verification and recognition are defined as distinct operations, and it states each element of the design as a proposition that can be tested rather than as a claim that has been demonstrated. The central argument is deliberately narrow. Distributed ledger technology can make a claim about learning independently verifiable, but it cannot make that claim socially recognized, and the difference between verification and recognition is where earlier blockchain university proposals failed. OOU is therefore positioned not as a replacement for existing open universities but as a shared trust layer that established institutions, quality assurance bodies, and learner communities can adopt alongside emerging public infrastructures such as the European Blockchain Services Infrastructure. The paper gives equal weight to the constraints on this vision, including the tension between ledger immutability and the right to erasure identified by the European Data Protection Board, the credential-farming incentives created by tokenized rewards, the keymanagement burden placed on learners, and the risk that fine-grained credentialing accelerates the fragmentation of curricula that critics of micro-credentials have documented. Two configurations are proposed, one institutional and non-tokenized and one open and tokenized, so that the pedagogical architecture can be evaluated independently of the financial one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"开放链上大学"（OOU）设计愿景——基于去中心化标识符、可验证凭证和学习分析的开放、学习者拥有的认证与认可基础设施，并明确区分了"验证"与"社会认可"两个概念，指出分布式账本技术只能解决前者而不能解决后者。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个开放、学习者拥有的证书颁发与认可基础设施，使开放远程教育中的学习证据能够跨机构、跨边界独立验证并获得社会认可？
AI.motivation: 开放远程教育虽已惠及数千万学习者，但学习证据仍由机构掌控、行政上不透明且在跨境验证方面困难重重。早期区块链大学方案未能区分"验证"与"社会认可"的差异，导致失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于作者前期关于智能开放教育生态系统的范围综述（Fırat, 2023），融合去中心化标识符、可验证凭证、学习分析及分布式账本技术等概念框架。
AI.method: 概念性/设计研究而非实证研究。提出设计原则、五层参考架构、治理模型和分阶段实施路线图；将学习证明（Proof-of-Learning）形式化为五元组；将设计的每个要素表述为可检验的命题。
AI.findings: 核心论点：分布式账本技术能使学习主张独立可验证，但不能使其获得社会认可；验证与认可之间的区别正是早期区块链大学方案失败之处。据此提出两种配置——制度性非代币化配置与开放性代币化配置，以便将教学架构与金融架构分开评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了Proof-of-Learning五元组构造，将验证和认可定义为不同操作；将"验证"与"社会认可"的区分理论化，为区块链教育应用提供了更精细的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可检验的设计命题、五层参考架构、治理模型和分阶段实施路线图；将OOU定位为现有开放大学的共享信任层，可被既有机构、质量保障机构和学习者社区采用，并可与欧洲区块链服务基础设施等公共设施对接。

title: Regional STEM Infrastructure and Financial Risks Facing Young People: A Panel Analysis of Kazakhstan's Regions
affiliations: , Nazarbayev Intellectual School of Physics and Mathematics in Aktobe, S Seifullin Kazakh Agrotechnical Research University, S Seifullin Kazakh Agrotechnical Research University and Nazarbayev Intellectual School

detail.title: Regional STEM Infrastructure and Financial Risks Facing Young People: A Panel Analysis of Kazakhstan's Regions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The authors confirm that the research was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: This article examines the relationship between regional STEM infrastructure and the reconstructed volume of delinquent consumer debt among youth in the regions of the Republic of Kazakhstan from 2018 to 2024. The study is based on regional panel data, including indicators of STEM infrastructure, youth unemployment, household income, the share of the rural population, and characteristics of the regional consumer credit market. To assess statistical relationships, we use pooled ordinary least squares (OLS) regression and a linear mixed model (LMM) with a random intercept at the regional level, which allows us to account for persistent interregional heterogeneity. The robustness of the results is tested using an alternative equally weighted STEM index, various scenarios for reconstructing the dependent variable, additional control for the scale of the regional consumer credit market, and a specification with a one-year lag of the STEM index. The pooled OLS results show a positive, statistically significant relationship between the STEM index and the reconstructed volume of delinquent debt among young people (β = 9.452, p = 0.022). However, after accounting for persistent regional heterogeneity in the LMM, the coefficient for the current STEM index decreases and becomes statistically insignificant (β = 4.795, p = 0.392). The intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC = 0.620) indicates that regional clustering plays a significant role in the data structure. The main result holds when using an alternative equally-weighted STEM index and various scenarios for reconstructing the dependent variable. After additionally accounting for the size of the regional consumer credit market, the current STEM index also remains statistically insignificant (β = 0.830, p = 0.758), whereas the volume of consumer credit shows a positive, statistically significant relationship with reconstructed delinquent debt. The specification with a one-year lag of the STEM index yields a positive, statistically significant coefficient (β = 12.610; p = 0.043); however, this result is viewed as evidence of the sensitivity of the estimated relationship to the time specification and is not interpreted as a causal effect. The results show that the relationship between regional STEM infrastructure and youth credit risks, as observed at the aggregate level, depends significantly on accounting for persistent interregional differences, the size of the regional credit market, and the model's time specification. The study emphasizes the need to view STEM infrastructure as part of a broader regional educational, socioeconomic, and financial environment, rather than interpreting it as a direct determinant of young people's credit behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用2018-2024年哈萨克斯坦地区面板数据，考察区域STEM基础设施与青年逾期消费债务重建量之间的关系。混合OLS回归显示显著正相关，但在加入区域随机截距的线性混合模型后，该关系变得不显著；加入区域消费信贷市场规模或使用滞后STEM指数后结果也不稳健。研究表明STEM基础设施与青年信用风险的关系高度依赖于对区域异质性、信贷市场规模的把控及模型时间设定。
AI.research_question: 区域STEM基础设施是否与哈萨克斯坦青年逾期消费债务重建量存在统计关联？这种关联在控制区域持久异质性后是否依然成立？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在宏观层面讨论STEM教育与经济发展关系，但缺乏STEM基础设施与青年信用风险/违约行为之间关联的实证证据，尤其是在转型经济体区域层面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域人力资本理论与信用风险理论，涉及STEM基础设施作为区域人力资本投资对青年就业、收入及信用行为的传导机制。
AI.method: 采用2018-2024年哈萨克斯坦区域面板数据，运用混合OLS回归和含区域随机截距的线性混合模型(LMM)，并通过替代STEM指数、重构因变量场景、控制信贷市场规模及一年滞后期设定进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: (1)混合OLS显示STEM指数与青年逾期债务显著正相关(β=9.452, p=0.022)；(2)LMM控制区域异质性后系数变小且不显著(β=4.795, p=0.392)，ICC=0.620显示区域聚类重要；(3)控制信贷市场规模后STEM指数仍不显著，而信贷规模本身显著正相关；(4)一年滞后STEM指数系数显著(β=12.610, p=0.043)，但被视为时间设定敏感性而非因果证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了STEM基础设施与青年信用风险之间的关联在控制区域持久异质性后会消失，挑战了将STEM基础设施简单视为青年信用行为直接决定因素的简化观点，强调应将其置于更广泛区域教育社会经济金融环境中理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：不应将STEM基础设施建设视为直接降低青年信用风险的单一杠杆；政策设计需综合考虑区域信贷市场环境、经济条件等多重因素，避免过度简化STEM投资的政策效果归因。

title: Weather and Geopolitics Are Stress-Testing Europe's Clean Energy Transition: Wind, Water and the Price of the European Evening, 2015-2026

detail.title: Weather and Geopolitics Are Stress-Testing Europe's Clean Energy Transition: Wind, Water and the Price of the European Evening, 2015-2026
detail.abstract: European power prices are usually judged by an annual average. Read instead at the resolution the system runs at, one price per bidding zone per hour on a panel of 3.9 million zone-hours ending 10 August 2026, the clean transition has moved Europe's economic cycle in between a weather cycle and a political one. Summer 2026 had fifteen days on which ten or more of the 39 zones were hot at once against five in 2022, and heat reaches supply as well as demand. Fifteen of 35 river cooling sites ran at their lowest in 35 years, hydro's contribution to the evening climb halved from 8.9 to 4.3 GW, and gas covered the difference. Russian gas meanwhile fell from 42 per cent of extra-EU imports to about a tenth while liquefied gas rose to 44 per cent, a real diversification into a different form of exposure, and the defence budgets the same geopolitics requires draw on the fiscal space the grid needs. Solar carried the daytime this summer and cannot carry the evening, which falls to wind, hydro or fuel. Wind is the renewable whose share tracks national income, from 60 per cent of generation in Denmark to 1.4 in Hungary, so the member states with the widest gap between a cheap midday and a dear evening are the ones that have not built it. Adjacent zones clear at the same price in only 26 per cent of hours. Expanding wind, and building the wires and the agreement between zones that would let it be shared, is the binding constraint on completing the transition. This paper identifies that constraint from price and operating evidence, and it does not estimate the environmental or the total system cost of resolving it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析390万条区域-小时级数据（截至2026年8月10日），揭示清洁能源转型已将欧洲经济周期置于天气周期与政治周期之间。研究发现风电短缺是完成能源转型的约束瓶颈。
AI.research_question: 欧洲电力市场在清洁能源转型过程中面临的核心约束是什么？如何从价格和运营数据中识别这一约束？
AI.motivation: 传统上以年均值评估欧洲电价掩盖了系统运行的真实复杂性。夏季2026年出现的极端天气事件（39个区域中10个以上同时高温的天数从2022年的5天增至15天）暴露了转型中的结构性瓶颈，需要以更细粒度数据重新审视欧洲电力系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力市场时段定价理论；能源转型中的供需均衡分析；地缘政治与能源安全理论；可再生能源区域分布与电网互联理论。
AI.method: 对39个投标区域、每小时一个价格的3.9百万区域-小时面板数据进行实证分析，考察电力价格、发电结构、冷却水可用性、天然气进口来源及区域间价格趋同度等运营指标。
AI.findings: （1）2026年夏季极端高温事件显著多于2022年，热浪同时冲击供给与需求；（2）河流冷却能力达35年最低，水电对晚间爬坡的贡献从8.9GW降至4.3GW，由天然气补缺；（3）俄罗斯天然气占比从42%降至约10%，液化天然气升至44%，实现了向不同风险敞口的真实多元化；（4）太阳能支撑白天负荷但无法覆盖晚间，晚间需依赖风、水或燃料；（5）风电占比与国家收入高度相关（丹麦60% vs 匈牙利1.4%）；（6）相邻区域仅有26%的时段价格趋同，电网互联严重不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将电力系统分析从年均视角转向时段级视角，揭示风电与电网互联而非太阳能是能源转型的约束瓶颈；将能源转型置于天气周期与地缘政治周期的交叉分析框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲政策制定者指出完成能源转型的优先行动方向：扩大风电建设、加强跨区电网互联及区域间协调机制；警示国防预算与电网投资在财政空间上的竞争关系。

title: Chips and Megawatts: Structural Attribution in the AI Supply Chain, 2015-2026

detail.title: Chips and Megawatts: Structural Attribution in the AI Supply Chain, 2015-2026
detail.abstract: The artificial-intelligence supply chain is widely described as concentrated around its final buyers. This paper measures that description against a reference, comparing a 46-name basket of United States listings in every window of ten years against 200 control baskets drawn from the same sectors. Our analysis shows that the concentration is real and that it is not where the argument places it. Structural weight has been leaving the hyperscaler layer for a decade, by 6.4 percentage points, and accruing to the manufacturers of electrical equipment, whose order books track data-centre construction, while the regulated utilities usually bundled with them move the other way. The largest single gainer of the decade is a maker of grid apparatus rather than a chipmaker, and the migration replicates on European and Japanese universes against their own controls. The basket also behaves increasingly as one object rather than as 46 positions, which means less diversification inside a thematic sleeve than its name count suggests, although a category-driven explanation for that co-movement cannot be excluded by this design. Weight within the basket is distributed more unevenly than its co-movement accounts for, a result confined to United States listings. And while the basket falls roughly a quarter deeper than its sector peers when both fall, no network statistic anticipates when that happens, at any horizon between five and ninety days: these measures describe the present rather than forecast. Two methodological contributions travel beyond the case. Permutation against a matched control set is shown to be the appropriate inferential procedure for autocorrelated series of this kind, where interval estimates alone are insufficient. And networks inferred from raw market shares are shown to reproduce the signature of a captured ecosystem in the complete absence of any interaction, which bears on much of the visual argument currently made about this industry.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将46家美国AI供应链上市公司的篮子与200个同行业控制篮子进行置换检验，发现AI供应链的集中度确实存在，但其位置与普遍论述不同：结构性权重十年来从超大规模云厂商（hyperscaler）转移了6.4个百分点，流向电网设备制造商而非芯片制造商。篮子行为日益像单一对象而非46个独立仓位，但权重分布比其联动性所暗示的更不均匀（仅限美国上市）。篮子下跌时比同类行业深约四分之一，但网络统计量无法预测下跌时点。
AI.research_question: 人工智能供应链的集中度是否真实存在？如果存在，其集中位置在哪里？供应链篮子作为一个投资组合的联动性与权重分布特征如何？网络统计量能否预测该篮子的下跌时机？
AI.motivation: AI供应链被广泛描述为围绕最终买家（超大规模云厂商）高度集中，但这种描述缺乏系统性基准对照。作者希望通过严格的统计方法（控制篮子置换检验），检验这一普遍说法的真实性与准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链集中度理论、投资组合联动性理论、网络分析与生态系统涌现理论、置换检验统计推断框架
AI.method: 构建46家美国AI供应链上市公司篮子，在每十年窗口中与200个来自相同行业的控制篮子进行置换检验对比；分析权重转移（超大规模层流向电气设备制造商）；检验篮子内部联动性与权重分布不均匀性；检验5至90天不同时间跨度的网络统计量预测能力；在欧洲和日本股票池中进行稳健性验证；利用从市场份额推断的网络检验"被捕获生态系统"特征的假阳性问题。
AI.findings: （1）集中度真实存在但位置被误置：权重十年来从hyperscaler层流出6.4个百分点，流向电气设备制造商（受益于数据中心建设订单），而公用事业则反向移动；（2）十年最大赢家是电网设备制造商而非芯片制造商；（3）该迁移模式在欧洲和日本股票池中也复现；（4）篮子行为日益像单一对象，名义上46个仓位但实际分散化效果低于名称数量所暗示；（5）权重分布比联动性更不均匀，该现象仅限美国上市；（6）篮子下跌深度比同类行业深约四分之一，但任何网络统计量均无法在5-90天范围内预测下跌时点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出置换检验配合匹配控制集是分析此类自相关时间序列的适当推断程序，区间估计不足以支撑结论；证明从原始市场份额推断的网络在完全无交互的情况下也能再现"被捕获生态系统"的特征，对当前大量关于AI行业的视觉化网络论证提出了方法论挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者而言，揭示了AI主题投资篮子内部实际分散化程度低于名称数量暗示，且网络统计量不能用于时机预测；对政策制定者和产业分析者而言，指出AI供应链的重心已从超大规模云厂商向电气设备制造环节迁移，颠覆了传统认知。

title: Globalization—Quo Vadis?
affiliations: Skidmore College - Department of Economics

detail.title: Globalization—Quo Vadis?
detail.abstract: The Global Financial Crisis of 2008–9 provided a critical watershed in the evolving global economic rebalancing and re-shifting towards China and Asia. The era of unchallenged US hegemony and “hyperglobalization” came to an end. Since 2017 the Sino-American geostrategic rivalry has taken centerstage in global affairs and is bound to play a decisive role in in the future evolution of globalization. Against the backdrop of Dani Rodrik’s (2011) “political trilemma of the world economy”, this essay reviews two recently published books on the subject matter of globalization that provide invaluable insights and strategic guidance into what is at stake. The first was published in November 2025, a single-authored work by Dani Rodrik titled “Shared Prosperity in a Fractured World: A New Economics for the Middle Class, the Global Poor, and Our Planet” (Princeton University Press). The second is a collection of contributions by expert economists co-edited by Lili Yan Ing and Dani Rodrik titled “The New Global Economic Order” (Routledge).

AI.tldr: 本文以2008-09年全球金融危机为分水岭，审视全球经济重心向中国和亚洲转移的格局变化。在美中地缘战略竞争加剧的背景下，作者基于Rodrik（2011）的"全球经济政治三难困境"框架，评论了两本关于全球化的新书——Rodrik独著的《共享繁荣》和Ing与Rodrik合编的《新全球经济秩序》，为理解全球化的未来演变提供洞见与战略指引。
AI.research_question: 在中美地缘战略竞争与全球化格局重塑的背景下，如何理解全球化未来的演变方向及其面临的困境？
AI.motivation: 2008-9年全球金融危机标志着美国霸权和"超级全球化"时代的终结，自2017年以来中美地缘战略竞争成为全球事务的核心，全球化的未来走向充满不确定性。作者希望通过评述两本相关新书来厘清全球化面临的挑战与可能路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: Dani Rodrik（2011）提出的"全球经济政治三难困境"（political trilemma of the world economy），即国家主权、民主政治与深度全球化三者不可兼得的理论框架。
AI.method: 书评/评论性论述（essay/review），对两本关于全球化主题的新书进行批判性评述与分析。
AI.findings: 全球经济正从美国主导的"超级全球化"时代转向以中国和亚洲崛起为特征的新平衡格局；中美地缘战略竞争将持续主导全球事务并深刻影响全球化的未来演变；Rodrik的理论框架和相关新书为理解这些变化提供了宝贵的洞见和战略指引。
AI.theory_contributions: 运用Rodrik的"政治三难困境"框架来分析当代全球化的转型，将书评作为理论反思的载体，深化了对全球化演变背后的政治经济张力的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和学者提供关于全球化未来走向的战略指引，推荐两本关键著作以帮助理解全球经济再平衡和地缘政治竞争的实质。

title: Language-Based Cognitive Interventions: A Scoping Review of Linguistic Cues, Task-Framing, and Self-Directed Cognitive Change
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Language-Based Cognitive Interventions: A Scoping Review of Linguistic Cues, Task-Framing, and Self-Directed Cognitive Change

declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded by the author as part of a private research initiative under the Human Optimization Framework (HOF).

publicationDetails.detailsText: Preprint version is available on Zenodo, DOI: 10.5281/ZENODO.20492756

detail.abstract:
Language is often treated as a medium for describing psychological experience, communicating instructions, or reporting internal states. Across several areas of cognitive, affective, behavioral, and applied psychological research, however, language also functions as an operative cognitive interface. Words, phrases, written prompts, verbal labels, and structured instructions may direct attention, bind cues to actions, organize affective experience, modify appraisals, support selfregulation, and compress complex procedures into repeatable task-frames.

This scoping conceptual review maps major classes of language-based cognitive interventions and related experimental literatures, including implementation intentions, self-instruction and self-talk, cognitive reappraisal and cognitive restructuring, affect labeling, expressive writing, semantic priming and verbal cueing, verbal repetition and cue phrases, and protocol-based cognitive processing as an emerging observational category.

The review does not conduct a statistical meta-analysis, does not calculate pooled effect sizes, and does not make clinical efficacy claims for unvalidated systems. The review proposes that languagebased interventions can be understood through a set of partially overlapping functional roles: attentional pointer, semantic index, task-frame, cue-action binder, affect label, narrative organizer, self-regulatory scaffold, and procedural compression unit.

This framework may help clarify how structured language can organize self-directed cognitive operations while preserving appropriate boundaries between established evidence, mechanistic plausibility, and systems requiring independent empirical evaluation

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇范围性概念综述，系统梳理了语言作为操作性认知接口的各类基于语言的认知干预方法（如执行意图、自我对话、认知重评、情绪标记、表达性写作等），提出一套部分重叠的功能角色框架（如注意指针、语义索引、任务框架、线索-行为联结器等），用于理解结构化语言如何组织自我导向的认知操作，同时明确区分既有证据、机制合理性与需要独立验证的系统。
AI.research_question: 语言如何作为操作性认知接口（operative cognitive interface）而非仅仅作为描述心理经验的媒介，且不同语言类认知干预可如何通过统一的功能框架加以理解？
AI.motivation: 传统心理学通常将语言视为描述心理经验、传达指令或报告内部状态的媒介，但多个研究领域表明语言还发挥操作性认知功能。现有文献分散于不同干预类型中，缺乏统一的整合性视角来把握语言在认知干预中的共性作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出一组部分重叠的功能角色框架，包括：注意指针（attentional pointer）、语义索引（semantic index）、任务框架（task-frame）、线索-行为联结器（cue-action binder）、情绪标签（affect label）、叙事组织器（narrative organizer）、自我调节支架（self-regulatory scaffold）、程序压缩单元（procedural compression unit）。
AI.method: 范围性概念综述（scoping conceptual review），系统梳理语言类认知干预及相关实验文献，包括执行意图、自我指导与自我对话、认知重评与认知重构、情绪标记、表达性写作、语义启动与言语提示、言语重复与提示短语、基于协议认知加工等类别。不进行统计元分析。
AI.findings: 语言类干预可通过八个部分重叠的功能角色来理解：注意指针、语义索引、任务框架、线索-行为联结器、情绪标签、叙事组织器、自我调节支架和程序压缩单元。这一框架有助于阐明结构化语言如何组织自我导向的认知操作，同时保持既有证据、机制合理性与需独立实证评估的系统之间的适当界限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的语言功能角色分类框架，将分散于多个研究领域的语言类认知干预整合到一个概念体系下；从"语言作为描述媒介"转向"语言作为操作性认知接口"的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床和实证研究者在区分已验证干预与未经验证系统方面提供参考框架；有助于研究者更清晰地认识结构化语言在认知干预中的机制性作用，从而指导未来实证研究的设计。

title: When Does Intraday Options Trading Predict Stock Returns?
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics, Zhejiang University - Department of Finance and

detail.title: When Does Intraday Options Trading Predict Stock Returns?
detail.abstract: We aggregate signed options trading volume from CBOE and ISE and document a persistent positive predictive power of 30-minute options order imbalance (OOI) for next-day stock returns. OOI near the market close exhibits the strongest predictability, driven primarily by open-buy positions, high-leverage options, and small orders. Consistent with informed trading, options traders appear to time the liquidity across options and stock markets, and this predictability is stronger when option liquidity is high and stock liquidity is low. The predictive power also intensifies with firm-specific and macroeconomic information events. Finally, OOI also forecasts both stock price jumps and crash risks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用CBOE和ISE的期权交易数据，发现30分钟期权订单失衡（OOI）对次日股票收益具有持续的正向预测能力，且临近收盘时预测力最强，主要由开仓买入、高杠杆期权和小额订单驱动。期权交易者表现出跨市场流动性择时行为，预测力在期权流动性高、股票流动性低时更强，并在信息和宏观事件期间增强，同时还能预测股票价格跳跃和崩盘风险。
AI.research_question: 期权市场的订单失衡（OOI）是否能预测次日股票收益？其预测力的来源、机制和边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多关注股票自身订单流对收益的预测，对期权市场订单流信息含量及跨市场信息传递的研究不足，尤其是不同时间窗口和交易特征的异质性预测力尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知情交易理论；跨市场流动性择时假说；市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 基于CBOE和ISE聚合的期权交易数据，构建30分钟期权订单失衡（OOI）指标，通过回归分析检验其对次日股票收益的预测能力，并分组检验交易特征（开平仓、杠杆、订单规模）及市场条件（流动性、信息事件）的异质性影响。
AI.findings: （1）OOI对次日股票收益具有持续正向预测力；（2）临近收盘的OOI预测力最强；（3）预测力主要由开仓买入、高杠杆期权和小额订单驱动；（4）期权交易者存在跨市场流动性择时行为，期权流动性高、股票流动性低时预测力更强；（5）信息事件期间预测力增强；（6）OOI还能预测股价跳跃和崩盘风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了知情交易理论在期权市场的应用，揭示了期权订单流中蕴含的增量信息；提出并验证了跨市场流动性择时的知情交易机制，丰富了市场微观结构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于期权订单流的日内交易信号，可用于股票收益预测和风险管理；为市场监管者理解期权市场信息含量和跨市场信息传递提供了实证依据。

title: Scalable Share Calibration for Factor Multinomial Probit Models

detail.title: Scalable Share Calibration for Factor Multinomial Probit Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Employed by Global Strategic Minerals Corporation
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We give an algorithm that inverts observed shares to utilities in multinomial probit models with many alternatives, when the covariance is low-rank-plus-diagonal and supplied. Conditioning on the factors makes the alternatives independent, so one shared survival field prices all N alternatives in a single pass over Q factor nodes and L grid points, at O(QNL) cost. The same field yields resampling-free Jacobian-vector products, and share inversion at N = 1000 takes three seconds in the compiled implementation at rank two. Ten thousand alternatives stay under a minute. In convergence comparisons, the computed shares carry log-share errors of a few parts in a hundred thousand, hundred-to-one shares included. The established high-precision evaluators price one orthant at a time. The nearest factor-aware competitor computes the same share vector roughly 140× slower at matched accuracy at N = 1000, and the gap widens linearly in N .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种在多项式概率单位（multinomial probit）模型中高效反演市场份额为效用的算法，利用低秩加对角协方差结构，通过共享生存场（survival field）一次性对所有备选项进行定价，实现O(QNL)的计算复杂度，在N=1000时仅需3秒，比现有最快方法快约140倍。
AI.research_question: 如何在具有大量备选项的多项式概率单位模型中，高效地将观测到的市场份额反演为效用？
AI.motivation: 传统方法一次只能对单个正交区域（orthant）进行定价，无法高效处理大量备选项（如N=1000甚至10000）的市场份额反演问题，计算代价高昂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多项式概率单位模型（multinomial probit）；低秩加对角协方差结构；条件独立分解（conditioning on factors使备选项独立）；共享生存场（shared survival field）。
AI.method: 利用低秩加对角的协方差结构，通过对因子（factors）条件化使各备选项独立，构建共享生存场，在单个遍历中同时计算所有N个备选项的份额（O(QNL)复杂度）；同一生存场还可生成无需重采样的雅可比-向量积（Jacobian-vector products），用于份额反演。
AI.findings: 在N=1000、秩为2的编译实现中，份额反演仅需3秒；N=10000也在一分钟内完成。对数份额误差为十万分之几（包括100:1的极端份额比）。与最快的因子感知竞争方法相比，在匹配精度下速度提升约140倍，且差距随N线性扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了共享生存场方法，使得所有备选项可以一次性并行定价，打破了传统方法逐正交区域计算的瓶颈，建立了大规模多项式概率单位模型份额计算的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模备选项场景下的市场份额反演提供了可落地的快速算法，支持高达10000个备选项的实际应用，显著降低了计算时间成本。

title: Private Equity at 50: Hold Everything

detail.title: Private Equity at 50: Hold Everything
detail.abstract: Private Equity turns 50 this year. The industry was built on a simple model: buy companies, improve them, sell them, return the proceeds. For decades, that's exactly what happened. Then came the flood. PE's prolonged success transformed a specialist craft into a $10 trillion dollar industry. Scale doesn't just make complex systems bigger. It reorganizes them around new priorities. In PE, scale shifts emphasis away from performance-driven carried interest and toward AUM-driven enterprise value. Rising rates have exposed what this incentive shift already set in motion: firms are holding onto companies longer and longer. The resulting distribution drought-and a recent stretch of uninspiring performance-have PE under fire. The strain is real. But it's not universal. Just like not every 50-something buys a Porsche, not all of PE is in crisis. What you see in the headlines focuses on the behavior and circumstances of the largest firms. But their story isn't the whole story. The original model is still working. If you know where to look for it.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾私募股权（PE）行业50年的发展历程，指出行业从最初"买入-改进-卖出-返还收益"的简单模式，演变为规模达10万亿美元的巨型产业。规模扩大使行业重心从绩效驱动的附带权益（carried interest）转向资产管理规模（AUM）驱动的企业价值，叠加利率上升，导致基金持有公司时间延长、分配停滞、业绩表现不佳。然而，文章认为危机并非普遍存在——头条新闻聚焦于大型基金的困境，但原始商业模式在特定领域仍然有效。
AI.research_question: 私募股权行业在规模扩大后，其商业模式和激励机制发生了怎样的根本性转变？这种转变是否意味着行业整体面临危机？
AI.motivation: 私募股权行业已成立50年，规模膨胀至10万亿美元，但面临分配停滞和业绩不佳的批评。作者旨在区分行业头部企业的困境与整体行业状况，指出危机并非普遍存在，原始商业模式仍然有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规模效应理论——规模不只使复杂系统变大，还会围绕新优先级重组系统；激励机制理论——从绩效驱动的附带权益向AUM驱动的企业价值转变；企业生命周期视角——将PE行业类比为50岁中年人的处境。
AI.method: 该文为评论/观点分析文章，通过行业历史回顾、趋势分析和定性论证，对比行业早期模式与当前头部企业的行为偏差。
AI.findings: （1）PE的长期成功将专业化技艺转变为10万亿美元的大行业；规模使行业重点从绩效驱动的附带权益转变为AUM驱动的企业价值。（2）利率上升暴露了激励转变的后果——企业持有公司时间越来越长，导致分配干旱和业绩表现不佳。（3）但这种压力并非普遍存在，仅集中于最大型基金；原始商业模式在特定领域仍然有效运作。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解大型资产管理行业的规模效应提供框架——规模如何重塑激励机制和优先级；区分行业整体与头部企业行为的关系，挑战"一刀切"的行业叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和行业观察者提供启示：应关注PE行业的异质性，不应仅以最大型基金的表现来评判整个行业；指出原始PE模式在特定细分领域仍然可行，为寻找投资机会提供方向指引。

title: Reforms and Protests

detail.title: Reforms and Protests
detail.abstract: This paper studies how fiscal reform generates social resistance. I construct a novel highfrequency dataset linking every bill voted in the Hellenic Parliament between 2010 and 2017 to the daily incidence, duration, and composition of protests, strikes, and riots during one of the sharpest fiscal adjustments in recent history. Three findings emerge. First, protest is tightly linked to the legislative calendar: activity rises as fiscally consequential bills approach a vote and declines gradually afterward, while fiscally neutral bills generate little response. Second, resistance increases with the stakes of reform. Protest rises with both the breadth of legislation and its euro-denominated fiscal magnitude. Third, the incidence of adjustment matters. Holding fiscal magnitude fixed, protest responds strongly to spending-related reforms but not to revenue-related reforms. Union mobilization and the grievances cited in calls to riot-dominated by wage, benefit, and budget cuts-corroborate this composition effect. Roughly half of the protest activity surrounding a vote occurs after passage, when protest can no longer affect the bill's immediate legislative fate, a pattern consistent with an expressive component of collective action. The results suggest that the social resistance generated by fiscal consolidation depends not only on how much governments adjust, but also on how they do so.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010-2017年希腊议会每项法案投票与每日抗议、罢工和骚乱的高频匹配数据，研究财政改革如何引发社会抵抗。研究发现：抗议活动与立法日历紧密相关，财政相关法案在投票前后引发抗议高峰；抗议规模随改革广度和财政规模上升；在财政规模相同的情况下，支出类改革比收入类改革引发更强的抵抗；约一半的抗议发生在法案通过之后，体现了集体行动的"表达性"成分。
AI.research_question: 财政改革如何引发社会抵抗？财政整顿的规模与方式如何影响社会抗议的强度与时机？
AI.motivation: 财政整顿（austerity）往往引发大规模社会抗议，但现有研究缺乏高频数据来精确刻画抗议与立法过程之间的动态关系，也难以区分改革规模与改革方式（支出削减vs增税）对社会抵抗的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体行动理论（表达性行动 vs 工具性行动）、财政改革的政治经济学
AI.method: 构建2010-2017年希腊议会每项法案投票与每日抗议、罢工、骚乱事件的高频匹配数据集，进行事件研究分析（event study）和回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）抗议活动与立法日历紧密相关，具有财政后果的法案在投票前引发抗议上升，投票后逐渐下降，而财政中性法案几乎不引发抗议；（2）抗议规模随法案的立法广度和欧元计价的财政规模增加而上升；（3）在财政规模相同的情况下，支出类改革比收入类改革引发显著更强的抗议；（4）工会动员和骚乱引用的不满理由（以工资、福利和预算削减为主）印证了支出改革引发更强抵抗的构成效应；（5）约一半的抗议活动发生在法案通过之后，支持集体行动具有表达性成分的观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将集体行动理论中"表达性行动"与"工具性行动"的区分引入财政改革与社会抵抗的研究，证明了抗议不仅具有影响立法结果的工具目的，也包含表达不满的独立价值。同时，揭示了财政整顿的"方式"（支出vs收入）对社会抵抗的不对称影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了财政整顿策略选择的实证依据：社会抵抗不仅取决于调整的规模，还取决于调整的方式——支出削减比增税引发更大的社会抵抗，政府在设计财政整顿方案时需要权衡经济效率与社会稳定。

title: Rethinking Time-Series Momentum in Equity Portfolios: Common Signals, Long-Only Positioning, and No Need for Volatility Timing
affiliations: University of Agder - School of Business and Law

detail.title: Rethinking Time-Series Momentum in Equity Portfolios: Common Signals, Long-Only Positioning, and No Need for Volatility Timing
detail.abstract: This paper studies how time-series momentum (TSMOM) should be implemented when the traded assets belong to the same equity market. We compare conventional portfoliospecific Momentum with a common market-level Momentum signal, Long-Short with Long-Only positioning, and strategies with and without inverse-volatility scaling across a broad set of U.S. characteristic-sorted equity portfolios. The results show that a common market Momentum signal is systematically more effective than portfolio-specific Momentum, suggesting that these portfolios are primarily exposed to a shared market state rather than distinct portfolio-specific regimes. The preferred trading rule depends on the performance objective. Market-Momentum Long-Only delivers the strongest performance when evaluated by the Sharpe ratio, whereas Market-Momentum Long-Short performs best when evaluated by six-factor alpha. Conditional-state analysis explains this difference: nonpositive Market Momentum identifies a state with lower but still positive expected returns and substantially higher risk, while its factor-adjusted expected return is negative. Finally, volatility timing mainly improves weaker Long-Short strategies and adds little to the bestperforming specifications. Overall, effective TSMOM implementation within a common equity market requires reconsidering both the source of the Momentum signal and the appropriate response to unfavorable market states.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当交易资产属于同一股票市场时，时间序列动量（TSMOM）应如何实施。通过比较组合特定动量与共同市场动量信号、多空与多头持仓、以及是否使用逆波动率缩放等策略，发现共同市场动量信号系统性优于组合特定动量，且最优交易规则取决于绩效目标。
AI.research_question: 当所交易资产属于同一股票市场时，时间序列动量（TSMOM）应如何实施？具体包括：动量信号来源（组合特定 vs 市场共同）、持仓方向（多空 vs 多头）、以及波动率缩放方式的最优选择。
AI.motivation: 现有TSMOM文献主要关注跨资产或跨市场的实施，但同一股票市场内多个特征分类组合的TSMOM实施方式尚不清楚，特别是动量信号的来源和市场状态的应对策略需要重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列动量（TSMOM）理论、市场状态条件分析理论、因子定价模型（六因子alpha）
AI.method: 基于广泛的美国特征分类股票组合，对组合特定动量与市场共同动量信号、多头与多空持仓、有无逆波动率缩放等策略进行系统比较，并结合条件状态分析和六因子alpha评估。
AI.findings: （1）共同市场动量信号系统性优于组合特定动量，表明这些组合主要暴露于共同市场状态；（2）以夏普比率衡量时，市场动量多头策略表现最佳；以六因子alpha衡量时，市场动量多空策略表现最佳；（3）条件状态分析表明，非正的共同市场动量识别出预期收益较低但风险显著更高的状态，其因子调整后预期收益为负；（4）波动率定时主要改善较弱的多空策略，对最优策略贡献有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了同一股票市场内TSMOM实施中动量信号来源的重要性，说明组合主要暴露于共同市场状态而非各自特有的制度；提供了基于不同绩效目标选择不同交易规则的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为同一股票市场内的TSMOM实施提供了具体指导：应采用共同市场动量信号而非组合特定动量；根据绩效目标（夏普比率或alpha）选择多头或多空持仓；波动率缩放应针对较弱策略而非最优策略。

title: Aggregate Uncertainty and Rank-Based Enforcement in Collective Action

detail.title: Aggregate Uncertainty and Rank-Based Enforcement in Collective Action
detail.abstract: I study voluntary contributions to a collective project whose provision threshold is uncertain and whose lowest contributor is sanctioned after failure. A single distributional index characterizes when symmetric full provision is supportable. Its large-group behavior is governed by the upper-tail geometry of the threshold distribution, so distributions with identical means, variances, and support can have opposite enforceability properties. Under globally weak common deterrence and convex shortfall risk, the same index yields uniqueness against asymmetric and independently mixed Nash equilibria. For a uniform threshold with 0 ≤ v < D, we derive the unique symmetric atomless mixed equilibrium when 0 < p < D-v. We then prove, without imposing symmetry, that this equilibrium maximizes provision over the entire Nash-equilibrium set. Consequently, npn → ∞ is necessary for approximate provision along any Nash-equilibrium sequence and sufficient along the symmetric selection. When 0 ≤ v < D, the full-provision support and unique-equilibrium implementation thresholds coincide. We also identify a symmetric certain-failure equilibrium in which contributions are dissipated in rank competition. A design extension shows how upper-tail incentives and the lower endpoint jointly determine the asymptotically minimal sanction needed to support full provision and exclude this characterized coordination trap.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不确定门槛的集体项目自愿贡献问题，其中最低贡献者在项目失败后受到惩罚。作者提出了一个单一分布指数来刻画对称全额贡献何时可被维持，并发现该指数的大群体行为由门槛分布的上尾几何特征决定，即使均值、方差和支撑集相同的分布也可能具有相反的强制可行性。在全球弱共同威慑和凸短缺风险下，该指数还能导出非对称和独立混合纳什均衡的唯一性。文章对均匀门槛情形推导出唯一对称无原子混合均衡，并证明了该均衡在全部纳什均衡集中最大化贡献水平，为近似贡献的必要性和充分性条件提供了精确刻画。
AI.research_question: 在集体项目融资门槛不确定且最低贡献者受惩罚的机制下，什么条件能够支撑全额贡献均衡？该均衡在大群体中具有怎样的行为特征？
AI.motivation: 该研究关注不确定门槛下集体行动的经典难题：当提供门槛不确定，且存在对最低贡献者的惩罚机制时，个体自愿贡献的均衡性质尚未被系统刻画。作者希望建立统一的分布指数来简化和统一分析，并揭示门槛分布的上尾几何特征在群体规模趋大时如何主导均衡的可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于博弈论框架，特别是关于不确定性门槛的公共品自愿贡献博弈、纳什均衡（包括对称与非对称、混合策略均衡）、共同威慑和短缺风险等概念。
AI.method: 采用理论建模与博弈论分析方法，构建了门槛不确定且对最低贡献者施加惩罚的集体项目博弈模型，通过分布指数分析、对称与非对称均衡的比较静态分析、以及均匀门槛分布下的解析求解来完成论证。
AI.findings: （1）单一分布指数可完全刻画对称全额贡献的可支持性；（2）大群体行为由门槛分布的上尾几何决定，均值方差支撑集相同但上尾不同的分布可产生相反的强制可行性；（3）在全球弱共同威慑和凸短缺风险下，该指数决定非对称和独立混合纳什均衡的唯一性；（4）均匀门槛下存在唯一对称无原子混合均衡，且该均衡在全部纳什均衡中最大化了贡献水平；（5）npn → ∞是近似贡献的必要条件（沿任意纳什均衡序列）和充分条件（沿对称选择）；（6）全额贡献支持与唯一均衡实施阈值重合；（7）识别出对称确定失败均衡（贡献在排名竞争中耗散），并给出设计扩展以确定最小化所需惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了统一的分布指数来刻画不确定门槛博弈中全额贡献的支持条件，大幅简化了分析框架；（2）揭示了门槛分布的上尾几何（而非仅均值方差）对大群体行为的决定性作用，这是对现有文献的重要理论修正；（3）建立了对称均衡在全均衡集上的最优性，填补了该领域对非对称均衡研究的空白；（4）证明了npn→∞条件在任意纳什均衡序列上的必要性，加强了结论的普适性。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为设计集体项目融资机制提供了明确的惩罚下限指导——通过上尾激励与下端点共同决定实现全额贡献所需的最少惩罚；（2）识别出贡献在排名竞争中耗散的协调陷阱，并给出了排除这一陷阱的机制设计建议；（3）对政策制定者而言，帮助理解门槛不确定下的捐赠或融资博弈中应如何设置惩罚力度和门槛分布以促进有效集体行动。

title: Exploring the Role of Nature-Based Solutions for Climate Adaptation in the Agriculture Sector
affiliations: and Saitama University, Graduate School of Humanities and Social Sciences, Graduate School of Humanities and Social Sciences

detail.title: Exploring the Role of Nature-Based Solutions for Climate Adaptation in the Agriculture Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was recived for this study.

detail.abstract: Climate change impacts are more severe and frequent in countries vulnerable to climate. Evidence indicates that Nature-based solutions (NbS) are widely used as cost-effective and sustainable adaptation strategies; however, their effectiveness varies across ecological, institutional, and socio-economic contexts. Our understanding of NbS for agricultural climate adaptation remains limited. This study systematically reviews the role of NbS in agricultural adaptation using PRISMA guidelines. Using keywords such as “NbS,” “climate adaptation,” and “agriculture,” along with their synonyms, a total of 2696 related papers in Scopus were identified. After applying relevant filters, 1740 articles were selected. During screening, 301 studies were relevant to the objectives, and after full review, 21 articles were finalized for inclusion. The methodology across these studies is diverse, including empirical methods, choice experiments, spatial modelling, policy reviews, and household surveys. The study uses VOSviewer software for network analysis, revealing several interconnected factors related to NbS for agricultural adaptation. In the word cloud analysis, key terms such as “farmer,” “agriculture,” and “practices” emerge as important. This research finds that approaches such as agroforestry, Eco-based adaptation, natural flood management, and climate-resilient crops are most frequently examined. The evidence shows that NbS are particularly effective for small farmers; therefore, they should be prioritized. However, NbS face governance and financing challenges. To address these issues, public–private partnerships involving NGOs, NPOs, and NbS should be developed and implemented in consultation with stakeholders. Finally, the review highlights several research gaps and limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过PRISMA系统综述框架，对2696篇相关文献进行筛选，最终纳入21篇研究，系统回顾了自然解决方案（NbS）在农业气候适应中的作用。研究发现农林业、基于生态的适应、自然洪水管理和气候韧性作物是最常被研究的NbS方法，且对小农户特别有效，但面临治理和融资挑战，建议通过公私伙伴关系加以解决。
AI.research_question: 自然解决方案（NbS）在农业气候适应中扮演什么角色？其有效性如何在不同生态、制度和社会经济情境中体现？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对脆弱国家影响更为严重和频繁，尽管NbS被广泛认为是具有成本效益的可持续适应策略，但其有效性因生态、制度和社会经济背景而异，目前对NbS在农业气候适应中的作用理解仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PRISMA系统综述指南，结合VOSviewer网络分析和词云分析来识别NbS农业适应的关键因素和主题。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，遵循PRISMA指南，在Scopus数据库中使用关键词组合检索获取2696篇论文，经筛选后306篇文章纳入初筛，最终完整评审后纳入21篇。研究方法包括实证方法、选择实验、空间建模、政策综述和家庭调查，并使用VOSviewer进行网络分析。
AI.findings: 农林业、基于生态的适应、自然洪水管理和气候韧性作物是最常被研究的NbS方法；NbS对小农户特别有效，应优先考虑；但NbS面临治理和融资方面的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了NbS在农业适应中的研究现状，识别了关键研究主题和相互关联因素，填补了NbS在农业气候适应领域综合理解的空白，并指出了研究缺陷和局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议优先关注小农户的NbS实施；建议建立涉及非政府组织、非营利组织和NbS的公私伙伴关系，并与利益相关者协商制定和实施相关政策。

title: Low-Carbon Steel Before Cost Parity: Demand Heterogeneity, Carbon Pricing, and Market Formation

detail.title: Low-Carbon Steel Before Cost Parity: Demand Heterogeneity, Carbon Pricing, and Market Formation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper studies the conditions under which a market for low-carbon steel can emerge before low-carbon production reaches conventional cost parity. The framework links technologyspecific production costs and emissions intensity to heterogeneous downstream willingness to pay for reductions in embodied emissions. Carbon pricing reduces the relative cost disadvantage of cleaner production routes, while buyer heterogeneity determines the share of demand able to absorb the remaining green premium. Producers can therefore face a commercially meaningful market even before the low-carbon technology reaches full production-cost parity. The quantitative analysis calibrates conventional BF-BOF and alternative low-carbon steelmaking routes to industry and engineering benchmarks and uses Monte Carlo simulation to incorporate uncertainty in hydrogen, electricity, raw-material, and other input costs. The results show substantial differences in the carbon prices and input-cost conditions required for alternative technologies to become competitive. Scrap-based EAF and natural-gas-based DRI-EAF become economically attractive earlier than hydrogen-based primary steelmaking, while H 2-DRI-EAF offers deeper emissions reductions but remains more sensitive to hydrogen costs and the willingness of downstream buyers to pay a green premium. A central implication is that downstream buyer-side market formation can precede producerside cost parity. Heterogeneity in willingness to pay allows an addressable market to emerge while a positive green premium remains, particularly when carbon pricing reduces the effective cost disadvantage of low-emission production. The results therefore suggest that the transition to low-carbon steel is likely to depend on the joint evolution of carbon pricing, technology costs, and downstream demand rather than on technological cost parity alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了低碳钢市场在低碳生产技术达到传统成本平价之前能否形成的条件。通过将技术特定生产成本和排放强度与下游对隐含排放减少的异质支付意愿联系起来，发现碳定价减少清洁生产路线的相对成本劣势，而买方的异质性决定了能够吸收剩余绿色溢价的需朙份额。定量分析校准了传统BF-BOF和替代低碳炼钢路线，并用蒙特卡洛模拟纳入不确定性，结果表明废钢基EAF和天然气基DRI-EAF比氢基炼钢更早具有经济吸引力，下游买方侧市场形成可以先于生产侧成本平价。
AI.research_question: 低碳钢市场能否在低排放生产技术达到与传统生产技术成本平价之前形成？其形成需要什么样的条件？
AI.motivation: 低碳炼钢技术尚未达到成本平价，但市场能否提前形成对钢铁行业脱碳转型至关重要。作者希望探讨替代技术商业化前景不仅取决于生产成本，还取决于碳定价和下游需求侧的绿色溢价承受能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术特定生产成本与排放强度框架，结合下游异质支付意愿模型，以及碳定价对成本劣势的调节作用。
AI.method: 量化分析：校准传统BF-BOF和替代低碳炼钢路线的行业与工程基准数据，采用蒙特卡洛模拟纳入氢气、电力、原材料和其他投入成本的不确定性。
AI.findings: （1）替代技术实现竞争力所需的碳价格和投入成本条件差异显著；（2）废钢基EAF和天然气基DRI-EAF比氢基一次炼钢更早具有经济吸引力；（3）氢基DRI-EAF提供更深度减排，但对氢成本和下游绿色溢价支付意愿更敏感；（4）下游买方市场形成可以先于生产侧成本平价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"下游买方侧市场形成先于生产侧成本平价"的理论框架，挑战了传统以技术成本平价为核心的市场形成判断标准，强调需求异质性与碳定价的联合作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为钢铁行业脱碳转型提供政策启示：低碳钢铁转型依赖于碳定价、技术成本和下游需求的协同演化，而非仅依靠技术成本平价；为企业投资决策和碳定价政策设计提供量化依据。

title:
Convergence as a Mitigation Strategy 
How Synchronized Global Adoption of Clean Technologies Reduces Systemic Risk

detail.title:
Convergence as a Mitigation Strategy 
How Synchronized Global Adoption of Clean Technologies Reduces Systemic Risk
detail.abstract:
Synchronized global adoption of clean technologies acts as a powerful stabilizer for the modern macroeconomic system, which is increasingly strained by overlapping ecological, geopolitical, and financial crises. The report argues that fragmented energy transitions—where advanced economies accelerate decarbonization while emerging markets lag—create structural imbalances that amplify systemic risk. As noted in the document, “Fragmentation in technological adoption…creates severe structural imbalances. These imbalances manifest as extreme volatility in currency markets, localized energy crises, and compounding risks across critical global supply chains.”

Using thermodynamic models of technology diffusion and dynamic factor copula frameworks for financial stability analysis, the study demonstrates that synchronized adoption compresses cost curves, reduces heavy‑tailed market dependencies, and lowers the joint probability of multi‑sector distress. As the report states, “achieving global adoption convergence effectively flattens the systemic risk curve.”

The paper concludes that convergence is not merely a climate strategy but a macro‑systemic risk mitigation imperative. Coordinated global deployment of clean technologies restructures network geometry toward decentralized resilience, prevents cascading failures, and enables a low‑entropy steady state for the global economy.

AI.tldr: 本文认为清洁技术的全球同步采纳是现代宏观经济体系的重要稳定器。碎片化的能源转型（发达经济体加速脱碳而新兴市场滞后）会造成结构性失衡，放大系统性风险。通过热力学技术扩散模型和动态因子copula框架的分析，研究表明同步采纳能够压缩成本曲线、降低厚尾市场依赖、降低多部门联合困境概率，从而"压平系统性风险曲线"。论文结论是，清洁技术全球协同部署不仅是气候战略，更是宏观系统性风险缓释的必然要求。
AI.research_question: 清洁技术的全球同步采纳如何影响宏观经济体系的系统性风险？碎片化能源转型会产生何种结构性失衡及系统性风险放大机制？
AI.motivation: 现代宏观经济体系正面临生态、地缘政治和金融多重危机交叠的压力，而当前全球能源转型呈现碎片化趋势——发达经济体加速脱碳而新兴市场滞后，这种不均衡的转型路径可能产生结构性失衡，放大系统性风险。理解并量化同步采纳的稳定作用具有重要的宏观政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学模型（用于技术扩散分析）和动态因子copula框架（用于金融稳定性分析）
AI.method: 采用热力学模型模拟技术扩散过程，结合动态因子copula框架进行金融稳定性分析，评估同步采纳与非同步采纳情境下系统性风险指标的差异。
AI.findings: （1）碎片化的技术采纳会造成严重的结构性失衡，表现为货币市场极端波动、局部能源危机以及全球关键供应链的复合风险；（2）同步采纳能够压缩成本曲线、减少厚尾市场依赖、降低多部门联合困境概率；（3）全球采纳收敛可以有效地"压平系统性风险曲线"；（4）协同部署可重构网络几何结构，向去中心化韧性转变，防止级联失败，使全球经济达到低熵稳态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术创新扩散理论（热力学视角）与金融系统风险分析（动态copula框架）相结合，建立了从清洁技术采纳模式到宏观经济系统性风险传导机制的理论桥梁，提出了"全球采纳收敛压平系统性风险曲线"这一理论命题，扩展了能源转型治理与金融稳定性交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球清洁技术协调部署提供了系统性风险缓释层面的政策依据，强调能源转型协调国际合作的必要性，为多边机构推动全球清洁技术扩散收敛提供了风险管理论证。

title: Teaching Against Collapse: Gendered Political Economy and the Territorialization of Education in Fragmented Yemen
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Teaching Against Collapse: Gendered Political Economy and the Territorialization of Education in Fragmented Yemen

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This article advances a gendered political economy framework to examine how systemic educational collapse in Yemen simultaneously destroys, reproduces, and-under specific conditions-transforms structures of conflict and patriarchal authority. Drawing on 45 semistructured interviews with educators, community leaders, and local authorities across five governorates (Aden, Taiz, Hadramawt, Marib, and Sana'a), triangulated with humanitarian reports and peer-reviewed scholarship, the study argues that education in protracted conflict cannot be understood through humanitarian deficit frameworks alone. Instead, it must be analyzed as a terrain of political contestation where war economies, patriarchal bargains, and territorial governance fragment educational space. The analysis identifies three interconnected dynamics. First, the collapse of state financing has localized resource distribution through patronage and community coercion, producing new geographies of educational exclusion.
